verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן מְשָׁרֵת מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now it was, after the death of Moshe traditional English “Moses.” , the servant of YHWH etc.). the servant of YHWH: The use of this title links the beginning of Joshua to the conclusion of Deuteronomy (34:5), emphasizing the unbroken continuity between Moshe and his successor. The term is also attached to David and some of the kings of Judah who followed him, indicating the concept of the sacred task of the biblical leader (Gray 1986). Regarding Moshe it is used fourteen times in the book of Joshua, a significant patterned number (two times seven). ,that YHWH said to Yehoshua trad. English “Joshua.” son of Nun, the attendant of Moshe, saying:

verses.hebrew: מֹשֶׁה עַבְדִּי מֵת וְעַתָּה קוּם עֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה אַתָּה וְכָל־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Moshe my servant is dead.So-now, arise, cross) in the spirit of “go cross,” or “go ahead and cross.” this Jordan,you and all this people,into the land that I am giving to them, to the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרֹךְ כַּף־רַגְלְכֶם בּוֹ לָכֶם נְתַתִּיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread,to you I have given it,as I promised Moshe;

verses.hebrew: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר וְהַלְּבָנוֹן הַזֶּה וְעַד־הַנָּהָר הַגָּדוֹל נְהַר־פְּרָת כֹּל אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וְעַד־הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ יִהְיֶה גְּבוּלְכֶם׃
verses.english: from the Wilderness and this Levanon trad. English “Lebanon,” the “white” mountain range to the north of Israel, from which the present-day country derives its name. up to the Great River, the River Euphrates,all the land of the Hittites as far as the Great Sea, toward the coming in of the sun,shall be your territory can also, as often throughout the book, mean “border, boundary.”.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ לְפָנֶיךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא אַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ׃
verses.english: No man will stand up before you, all the days of your life;as I was with Moshe, I will be with you,I will not desert you, I will not abandon you!

verses.hebrew: חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תַּנְחִיל אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם׃
verses.english: Be strong and courageous. As God has already said to Moshe in Deut. 31:6; Moshe, in turn, similarly exhorts both people and Yehoshua in 31:7 and 23.,for you yourself will cause this people to inherit the landthat I swore to your fathers to give them.

verses.hebrew: רַק חֲזַק וֶאֱמַץ מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכָל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ מֹשֶׁה עַבְדִּי אַל־תָּסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּיל בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃
verses.english: Only: be exceedingly strong and courageousto take care to observe exactly the Instruction that Moshe my servant commanded you;do not turn aside from it, right or left,in order that you may prosper wherever you go.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָמוּשׁ סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה מִפִּיךָ וְהָגִיתָ בּוֹ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה לְמַעַן תִּשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכָל־הַכָּתוּב בּוֹ כִּי־אָז תַּצְלִיחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶךָ וְאָז תַּשְׂכִּיל׃
verses.english: This Record of the Instruction. It is not clear what is meant here; at this point in the Bible, the phrase does not refer to the Five Books of Moses, as it commonly does later. The word sefer, used to mean “book” in later centuries, in the Bible can cover all kinds of written documents. is not to depart from your mouth—you are to recite indicates a low murmur, in the oral style of ancient study (see also Ps. 1:2). it day and night,in order that you may take care to observeexactly what is written in it;for then you will make your way prosper,then you will excel.

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִיךָ חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ אַל־תַּעֲרֹץ וְאַל־תֵּחָת כִּי עִמְּךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃
verses.english: Have I not commanded you:be strong and courageous!?Do not be terrified, do not be dismayed,for with you is YHWH your God, wherever you go!

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־שֹׁטְרֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua commanded the officials of the people, saying:

verses.hebrew: עִבְרוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה וְצַוּוּ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר הָכִינוּ לָכֶם צֵידָה כִּי בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃
verses.english: Cross through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying:Prepare yourselves provisions,for in another three days, you will be crossing this Jordanto come to take possession), which can sometimes mean “dispossess,” weaves throughout the book. In simplest form, it underlines “the juridical right to land by virtue of conquest” (Mitchell). of the land that YHWH your God is giving you to possess.

verses.hebrew: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now to the Re’uvenites and to the Gadites and to the half tribe of Menashe) is trad. English “Reuben,” while “Menashe” (pronounced me-nah-SHEH) is “Manasseh.” These three groups, back in Num. 32, had requested that they be permitted to settle on the east bank of the Jordan. There they agreed to participate with their fellow Israelites in the conquest of Canaan (on the West Bank)., Yehoshua said, saying:

verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מֵנִיחַ לָכֶם וְנָתַן לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: Be mindful of the word that Moshe the servant of YHWH commanded you, saying:YHWH your God is granting you rest, and will give you this land;

verses.hebrew: נְשֵׁיכֶם טַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵיכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם תַּעַבְרוּ חֲמֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם כֹּל גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּם אוֹתָם׃
verses.english: your wives, your little-ones, and your livestock, may also have the wider connotation of “stragglers,” thus including the infirm and the aged. will stayin the land that Moshe gave them across the Jordan,while you cross over, fully-armed, before your brothers,all the mighty-men of valor,and help them

verses.hebrew: עַד אֲשֶׁר־יָנִיחַ יְהוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם־הֵמָּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אוֹתָהּ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: until YHWH grants rest to your brothers like you,and they too take possession of the landthat YHWH your God is giving them,and you return to the land of your possession and possess it,which Moshe the servant of YHWH gave you across the Jordan,at the rising-place of the sun.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתָנוּ נַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ׃
verses.english: They answered Yehoshua, saying:Everything that you have commanded us, we will do,everywhere that you send us, we will go—

verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן נִשְׁמַע אֵלֶיךָ רַק יִהְיֶה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: just as we hearkened to Moshe, so we will hearken to you!Only: may YHWH your God be with you, as he was with Moshe!

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַמְרֶה אֶת־פִּיךָ וְלֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּצַוֶּנּוּ יוּמָת רַק חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ׃
verses.english: Every man who defies your orders, and does not hearken to your words exactly as you command him, shall be put to death.Only: be strong and courageous!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ־בִּן־נוּן מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים שְׁנַיִם־אֲנָשִׁים מְרַגְּלִים חֶרֶשׁ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ רְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְאֶת־יְרִיחוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וּשְׁמָהּ רָחָב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ־שָׁמָּה׃
verses.english: Yehoshua son of Nun sent two men, spies, from Shittim, denotes acacia trees. secretly, saying:Go, look over the land, especially Jericho. One of the oldest cities in the world, it lies near the Dead Sea, with the surrounding hills rising several thousand feet toward the central plateau of Judah. !They went and they came to the house of a whore woman—her name was Rahav); trad. English “Rahab.” The name resembles a verb that means “to widen.”—and they lay down there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָמַר לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אֲנָשִׁים בָּאוּ הֵנָּה הַלַּיְלָה מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחְפֹּר אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The king of Jericho was told, saying:Here, some men have come here tonight from the Children of Israel to search out the land!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ אֶל־רָחָב לֵאמֹר הוֹצִיאִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּאִים אֵלַיִךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ לְבֵיתֵךְ כִּי לַחְפֹּר אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ׃
verses.english: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahav, saying:Bring out the men who came to you, who came to your house,for it is to search out the entire land that they have come!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וַתִּצְפְּנוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר כֵּן בָּאוּ אֵלַי הָאֲנָשִׁים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מֵאַיִן הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: But the woman took the two men and concealed them;then she said:Certainly, the men came to me,but I do not know where they were from.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַשַּׁעַר לִסְגּוֹר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יָצָאוּ לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אָנָה הָלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים רִדְפוּ מַהֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם כִּי תַשִּׂיגוּם׃
verses.english: And it was, as the gate was about to be closed at dark, that the men went out—I do not know where the men went.Pursue quickly after them,for you may overtake them!

verses.hebrew: וְהִיא הֶעֱלָתַם הַגָּגָה וַתִּטְמְנֵם בְּפִשְׁתֵּי הָעֵץ הָעֲרֻכוֹת לָהּ עַל־הַגָּג׃
verses.english: Now she had brought them up to the roofand had hidden them in the stalks of flax, the ones arranged by her on the roof.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַל הַמַּעְבְּרוֹת וְהַשַּׁעַר סָגָרוּ אַחֲרֵי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ הָרֹדְפִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now the men pursued after them by way of the Jordan at the river-crossings,and they closed the gate, after the pursuers had gone out after them.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּן וְהִיא עָלְתָה עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־הַגָּג׃
verses.english: As for them, scarcely had they lay down when she The emphasis points out her energy (Hawk 2000). came up to them on the roof.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־נָתַן יְהוָה לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְכִי־נָפְלָה אֵימַתְכֶם עָלֵינוּ וְכִי נָמֹגוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: She said to the men:I knowthat YHWH has given you the land,and that the dread of you has fallen upon us;all the settled-folk of the land are quivering before you!

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַעְנוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהוָה אֶת־מֵי יַם־סוּף מִפְּנֵיכֶם בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם לִשְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן לְסִיחֹן וּלְעוֹג אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּם אוֹתָם׃
verses.english: For we heard about [how] YHWH dried up the waters of the Sea of Reeds before you when you went out of Egypt,and what you did to the two Amorite kings who were across the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og and OG (with “o” as in “old”). See Num. 21:21–35, where the Israelites encounter and defeat these two kings east of the Jordan. They are subsequently used as examples in narrating God’s great deeds on Israel’s behalf. ,whom you devoted-to-destruction), used frequently in Joshua, indicates people, animals, or objects set aside exclusively for God, often meaning wholesale destruction or death. Israel’s Moabite neighbors also spoke of herem in respect to their national god Kemosh, in the Mesha Stele (“Moabite Stone,” discovered in Jordan in 1868). The word appears in Arabic and has entered English as “harem,” signifying a group of women set apart for one man..

verses.hebrew: וַנִּשְׁמַע וַיִּמַּס לְבָבֵנוּ וְלֹא־קָמָה עוֹד רוּחַ בְּאִישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת׃
verses.english: We heard, and our hearts melted [in fear],and no life-breath rose within anyone because of you,for YHWH your God, he is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעוּ־נָא לִי בַּיהוָה כִּי־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּכֶם חָסֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם עִם־בֵּית אָבִי חֶסֶד וּנְתַתֶּם לִי אוֹת אֱמֶת׃
verses.english: So-now, pray swear to me by YHWH, that since I have acted toward you with loyalty,you also will act toward my Father’s House with loyaltyand will give me a trustworthy sign;

verses.hebrew: וְהַחֲיִתֶם אֶת־אָבִי וְאֶת־אִמִּי וְאֶת־אַחַי וְאֶת־אחותי [אַחְיוֹתַי] וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְהִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ מִמָּוֶת׃
verses.english: you will keep alive my father and my mother and my brothers and my sisters, and all those belonging to them,and save our lives from death!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ הָאֲנָשִׁים נַפְשֵׁנוּ תַחְתֵּיכֶם לָמוּת אִם לֹא תַגִּידוּ אֶת־דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיָה בְּתֵת־יְהוָה לָנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃
verses.english: The men said to her:Our life [shall be] in place of yours, to die, as long as you do not tell this business of ours!And it will be, at YHWH’s giving the land to us,that we will act toward you in loyalty and faithfulness.

verses.hebrew: וַתּוֹרִדֵם בַּחֶבֶל בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן כִּי בֵיתָהּ בְּקִיר הַחוֹמָה וּבַחוֹמָה הִיא יוֹשָׁבֶת׃
verses.english: Then she let them down by a rope through the window—for her house was on the outer-part of the wall, and in the wall she dwelt—

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָהָרָה לֵּכוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם הָרֹדְפִים וְנַחְבֵּתֶם שָׁמָּה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים עַד שׁוֹב הָרֹדְפִים וְאַחַר תֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכְּכֶם׃
verses.english: and she said to them:To the highlands go, lest the pursuers encounter you,and hide yourselves there for three days, until the pursuers’ return;afterward you may go on your way.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶיהָ הָאֲנָשִׁים נְקִיִּם אֲנַחְנוּ מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּנוּ׃
verses.english: The men said to her:We are clear of this your sworn-oath which you have had us swear:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ בָאִים בָּאָרֶץ אֶת־תִּקְוַת חוּט הַשָּׁנִי הַזֶּה תִּקְשְׁרִי בַּחַלּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הוֹרַדְתֵּנוּ בוֹ וְאֶת־אָבִיךְ וְאֶת־אִמֵּךְ וְאֶת־אַחַיִךְ וְאֵת כָּל־בֵּית אָבִיךְ תַּאַסְפִי אֵלַיִךְ הַבָּיְתָה׃
verses.english: here, when we come to the land,this cord also means “hope.” of scarlet thread you are to tie in the window through which you let us down,while your father and your mother and your brothers and all your Father’s Household you are to gather to yourself into the house;

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא מִדַּלְתֵי בֵיתֵךְ הַחוּצָה דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְקִיִּם וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה אִתָּךְ בַּבַּיִת דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשֵׁנוּ אִם־יָד תִּהְיֶה־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: and it shall be: whoever goes out of the doors of your house, outside,his blood will be on his head,and we will be clear,while whoever will be with you in the house,his blood will be on our head, if [any] hand be against him!

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־תַּגִּידִי אֶת־דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיִינוּ נְקִיִּם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּנוּ׃
verses.english: Now if you tell this business of ours, we will be clear from your sworn-oath that you have had us swear.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר כְּדִבְרֵיכֶם כֶּן־הוּא וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁר אֶת־תִּקְוַת הַשָּׁנִי בַּחַלּוֹן׃
verses.english: She said:In accordance with your words, so be it!So she sent them off, and they went,and she tied the scarlet cord through the window.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָהָרָה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים עַד־שָׁבוּ הָרֹדְפִים וַיְבַקְשׁוּ הָרֹדְפִים בְּכָל־הַדֶּרֶךְ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃
verses.english: They went off and came to the highlands, and stayed there for three days,until the pursuers returned;the pursuers sought them all along the way, but did not find [them].

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהָהָר וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ אֵת כָּל־הַמֹּצְאוֹת אוֹתָם׃
verses.english: The two men came down again from the highlands;they crossed over and came to Yehoshua son of Nun, and recounted to him all that had befallen them:

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי־נָתַן יְהוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ וְגַם־נָמֹגוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ׃
verses.english: they said to Yehoshua:Indeed, YHWH has given the entire land into our hand,and also all the settled-folk of the land are quivering before us!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַשִּׁטִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכָל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּלִנוּ שָׁם טֶרֶם יַעֲבֹרוּ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua started-early in the morning;they marched on from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the Children of Israel,and they spent the night there, before they crossed over.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַיַּעַבְרוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים בְּקֶרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: Now it was at the end of three daysthat the officials crossed into the midst of the camp

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוּוּ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר כִּרְאוֹתְכֶם אֵת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאִים אֹתוֹ וְאַתֶּם תִּסְעוּ מִמְּקוֹמְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: and commanded the people, saying:When you see the Coffer of the Covenant of YHWH your Godwith the priests and the Levites carrying it,you yourselves are to march on from your placeand walk behind it.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ רָחוֹק יִהְיֶה בֵּינֵיכֶם ובינו [וּבֵינָיו] כְּאַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה בַּמִּדָּה אַל־תִּקְרְבוּ אֵלָיו לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר־תֵּדְעוּ אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ כִּי לֹא עֲבַרְתֶּם בַּדֶּרֶךְ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃
verses.english: However—let it be far between you and it, about two thousand cubits in measure;do not come near it,in order that you may know the way that you are to go,for you have not crossed that way yesterday [or] the day-before.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם הִתְקַדָּשׁוּ כִּי מָחָר יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם נִפְלָאוֹת׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said to the people:Make yourselves holy,for tomorrow YHWH will perform wonders in your midst!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר שְׂאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וְעִבְרוּ לִפְנֵי הָעָם וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וַיֵּלְכוּ לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua said to the priests, saying:Carry the Coffer of the Covenantand cross over before the people!So they carried the Coffer of the Covenantand walked before the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָחֵל גַּדֶּלְךָ בְּעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יֵדְעוּן כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Yehoshua:Today I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Israel,that they may knowthat as I was with Moshe, I will be with you!

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן־הַבְּרִית לֵאמֹר כְּבֹאֲכֶם עַד־קְצֵה מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּיַּרְדֵּן תַּעֲמֹדוּ׃
verses.english: And you, command the priests, those carrying the Coffer of the Covenant, saying:When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan,in the Jordan you are to stand-still.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גֹּשׁוּ הֵנָּה וְשִׁמְעוּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said to the Children of Israel:Approach here and hearken to the words of YHWH your God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּזֹאת תֵּדְעוּן כִּי אֵל חַי בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְהוֹרֵשׁ יוֹרִישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת־הַחִתִּי וְאֶת־הַחִוִּי וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי וְאֶת־הַגִּרְגָּשִׁי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua said:By this you shall knowthat the Living God. The phrase probably carries the connotation of “active,” “vital”; I could not find an adequate English translation. is in your midst,and that he will dispossess, yes, dispossess from before youthe Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivvite,the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Yevusite:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ עֹבֵר לִפְנֵיכֶם בַּיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: here is the Coffer of the Covenant;the Lord of All the Earth is crossing over before you into the Jordan!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ לָכֶם שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר אִישׁ מִשִּׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ־אֶחָד אִישׁ־אֶחָד לַשָּׁבֶט׃
verses.english: So-now, take yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel,one man, one man [apiece] per tribe.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּנוֹחַ כַּפּוֹת רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ בְּמֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן יִכָּרֵתוּן הַמַּיִם הַיֹּרְדִים מִלְמָעְלָה וְיַעַמְדוּ נֵד אֶחָד׃
verses.english: It will be, when the soles of the feet of the priests, thosecarrying the Coffer of YHWH, the Lord of All the Earth, come to rest in the waters of the Jordan,the waters of the Jordan will be cut off;as for the waters coming down, echoing the name of the river Jordan (Heb. Yarden, “The Descender”). from above—they will stand as one heap!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָעָם מֵאָהֳלֵיהֶם לַעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן הַבְּרִית לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃
verses.english: So it was, at the people’s marching from their tents to cross the Jordan,with the priests, those carrying the Coffer of the Covenant, before the people:

verses.hebrew: וּכְבוֹא נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְרַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן נִטְבְּלוּ בִּקְצֵה הַמָּיִם וְהַיַּרְדֵּן מָלֵא עַל־כָּל־גְּדוֹתָיו כֹּל יְמֵי קָצִיר׃
verses.english: that when those carrying the Coffer came to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests, those carrying the Coffer, dipped in the edge of the water—the Jordan being full to its banks, all the days of the harvest-cutting—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הַמַּיִם הַיֹּרְדִים מִלְמַעְלָה קָמוּ נֵד־אֶחָד הַרְחֵק מְאֹד באדם [מֵאָדָם] הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר מִצַּד צָרְתָן וְהַיֹּרְדִים עַל יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם־הַמֶּלַח תַּמּוּ נִכְרָתוּ וְהָעָם עָבְרוּ נֶגֶד יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: the waters stood still, those coming down from above;they rose as one heap, very far away, at Adam, the town that is beside Tzaretan,while those going down to the Sea of the Plain, the Sea of Salt, were completely cut off,and the people crossed over, opposite Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה בֶּחָרָבָה בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן הָכֵן וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹבְרִים בֶּחָרָבָה עַד אֲשֶׁר־תַּמּוּ כָּל־הַגּוֹי לַעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: And the priests, those carrying the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant, stood fast on dry-ground, in the middle of the Jordan,while all Israel crossed over onto dry-ground,until the entire nation) rarely used of Israel; more common is the kinship-based term “people” (’am). Its usage here suggests that the crossing of the Jordan is an act of nation-founding. had completed crossing over the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּמּוּ כָל־הַגּוֹי לַעֲבוֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now it was, when the entire nation had completely crossed over the Jordan,that YHWH said to Yehoshua, saying:

verses.hebrew: קְחוּ לָכֶם מִן־הָעָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ־אֶחָד אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִשָּׁבֶט׃
verses.english: Take yourselves from the people twelve men: one man, one man [apiece] per tribe,

verses.hebrew: וְצַוּוּ אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר שְׂאוּ־לָכֶם מִזֶּה מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן מִמַּצַּב רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הָכִין שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אוֹתָם עִמָּכֶם וְהִנַּחְתֶּם אוֹתָם בַּמָּלוֹן אֲשֶׁר־תָּלִינוּ בוֹ הַלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: and command them, saying:Lift you up from here, from the middle of the Jordan, from the firmstanding-spot of the priests’ feet,twelve stones;have them cross over with youand place them at the night-lodging where you will lodge tonight.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־שְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִין מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ־אֶחָד אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִשָּׁבֶט׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua called for twelve men whom he had confirmed, from the Children of Israel,one man, one man [apiece] per tribe,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עִבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהָרִימוּ לָכֶם אִישׁ אֶבֶן אַחַת עַל־שִׁכְמוֹ לְמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and Yehoshua said to them:Cross over before the Coffer of YHWH your God, into the middle of the Jordan,and raise yourselves, each one, a stone onto his shoulder,corresponding to the number of tribes of the Children of Israel,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה זֹאת אוֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לָכֶם׃
verses.english: in order that this may be a sign in your midst:when your children ask you on the morrow, saying:What are these stones to you?

verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְרְתוּ מֵימֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה בְּעָבְרוֹ בַּיַּרְדֵּן נִכְרְתוּ מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהָיוּ הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לְזִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: you are to say to themthat the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the Coffer of the Covenant of YHWH;when it crossed into the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off.And these stones are to be a reminder to the Children of Israel, into the ages!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׂאוּ שְׁתֵּי־עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲבִרוּם עִמָּם אֶל־הַמָּלוֹן וַיַּנִּחוּם שָׁם׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel did thus, as Yehoshua had commanded:they lifted up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan,as YHWH had spoken to Yehoshua,corresponding to the number of tribes of the Children of Israel,and had them cross over with them to the lodging-place, and deposited them there.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן תַּחַת מַצַּב רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And the twelve stones Yehoshua erected in the middle of the Jordan, beneath the firmstanding-spot of the priests’ feet, those carrying the Coffer of the Covenant;they are there until this day.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן עֹמְדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד תֹּם כָּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הָעָם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְמַהֲרוּ הָעָם וַיַּעֲבֹרוּ׃
verses.english: Now the priests, those carrying the Coffer, were standing fast in the middle of the Jordan,until all the matter that YHWH had commanded Yehoshua to speak to the people was completed,exactly as Moshe had commanded Yehoshua;the people went quickly, and they crossed over.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּם כָּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֲרוֹן־יְהוָה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃
verses.english: And it was, when all the people had completed crossing over,that the Coffer of YHWH and the priests crossed over before the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה חֲמֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: And the Children of Re’uven, the Children of Gad, and the half tribe of Menashe crossed over, armed, before the Children of Israel,as Moshe had spoken to them;

verses.hebrew: כְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי הַצָּבָא עָבְרוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל עַרְבוֹת יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: about forty units as a military “contingent,” thus reducing the numbers drastically in these stories. The same reduction may be true for the Torah’s enumeration of those who left Egypt, which at first blush indicates over six hundred thousand warriors. of specially-drafted, “removed”) from among the normal soldiers. [men] from the armed-forces crossed over in the presence of YHWH to battle,to the Plains of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא גִּדַּל יְהוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרְאוּ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃
verses.english: On that day YHWH made Yehoshua great in the eyes of all Israel;they held him in awe, just as they had held Moshe in awe,all the days of his life.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Then YHWH said to Yehoshua, saying:

verses.hebrew: צַוֵּה אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְיַעֲלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: Command the priests, those carrying the Coffer of the Testimony,that they should come up from the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua commanded the priests, saying:Come up from the Jordan!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בעלות [כַּעֲלוֹת] הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן נִתְּקוּ כַּפּוֹת רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶל הֶחָרָבָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מֵי־הַיַּרְדֵּן לִמְקוֹמָם וַיֵּלְכוּ כִתְמוֹל־שִׁלְשׁוֹם עַל־כָּל־גְּדוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: And it was, upon the coming up of the priests, those carrying the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant, from the middle of the Jordan,—the soles of the priests’ feet were drawn up onto the dry-ground—that the waters of the Jordan returned to their placeand went on as yesterday [and] the day-before, to all their banks.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעָם עָלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְגָּל בִּקְצֵה מִזְרַח יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: Now the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth of the first month,and encamped at Gilgal/Circle, at the sunrise edge of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃
verses.english: And these twelve stones that they had taken from the Jordan, Yehoshua erected at Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: He said to the Children of Israel, saying:When your children ask their fathers on the morrow, saying:What are these stones?

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לֵאמֹר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה עָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: You are to make known to your children, saying:On dry-land did Israel cross this Jordan,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶת־מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵיכֶם עַד־עָבְרְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְיַם־סוּף אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ מִפָּנֵינוּ עַד־עָבְרֵנוּ׃
verses.english: when YHWH your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you, until your crossing over,just as YHWH your God had done at the Sea of Reeds, which he dried up before us, until our crossing over—

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יַד יְהוָה כִּי חֲזָקָה הִיא לְמַעַן יְרָאתֶם אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: in order that all the peoples of the earth might have knowledge of the hand of YHWH, how strong it is,in order that you might hold YHWH your God in awe, all the days [to come],

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ כָּל־מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַיָּם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהוָה אֶת־מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־עברנו [עָבְרָם] וַיִּמַּס לְבָבָם וְלֹא־הָיָה בָם עוֹד רוּחַ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now it was, when they heard—all the Amorite kings who were across the Jordan seaward,and all the Canaanite kings who were by the Sea,that YHWH had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the Children of Israel, until they had crossed over,their heart melted [in fear],and they were left breathless before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא אָמַר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים וְשׁוּב מֹל אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁנִית׃
verses.english: At that time, YHWH said to Yehoshua:Make yourself knives of flintand again circumcise the Children of Israel, a second time.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ־לוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים וַיָּמָל אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּבְעַת הָעֲרָלוֹת׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua made himself knives of flintand circumcised the Children of Israel, at the Hill of Foreskins.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־מָל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כָּל־הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם הַזְּכָרִים כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מֵתוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And this is the matter concerning which Yehoshua circumcised them:all the people coming out of Egypt, the males, all the men of battle,had died in the wilderness, on the way,upon their going out of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־מֻלִים הָיוּ כָּל־הָעָם הַיֹּצְאִים וְכָל־הָעָם הַיִּלֹּדִים בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא־מָלוּ׃
verses.english: For they had been circumcised, all the people who had gone out,while all the people who were born in the wilderness on the way, upon their going out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה הָלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד־תֹּם כָּל־הַגּוֹי אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לָהֶם לְבִלְתִּי הַרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃
verses.english: For the Children of Israel had traveled forty years in the wilderness,until the entire nation was gone, the men of battle, who had come out of Egypt,who had not hearkened to the voice of YHWH,those to whom YHWH swore that he would not let them see the landthat YHWH had sworn to their fathers to give them,a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם הֵקִים תַּחְתָּם אֹתָם מָל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי־עֲרֵלִים הָיוּ כִּי לֹא־מָלוּ אוֹתָם בַּדָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: But their children whom he had raised up in their place,them Yehoshua circumcised, for they were foreskinned,since they had not been circumcised on the way.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּמּוּ כָל־הַגּוֹי לְהִמּוֹל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲיוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Now it was, when the entire nation was done being circumcised,that they stayed in their place in the camp, until their recovery.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הַיּוֹם גַּלּוֹתִי אֶת־חֶרְפַּת מִצְרַיִם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא גִּלְגָּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And YHWH said to Yehoshua:Today I have rolled the disgrace of Egypt from off you!So the name of that place has been called Gilgal/Rolling, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַפֶּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel encamped at Gilgal,and they performed the Passover offering on the fourteenth day of the month, at sunset,in the Plains of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ מִמָּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח מַצּוֹת וְקָלוּי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: They ate from the yield of the land on the morrow of Passover: unleavened cakes and parched grain,on this very day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבֹּת הַמָּן מִמָּחֳרָת בְּאָכְלָם מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא־הָיָה עוֹד לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מָן וַיֹּאכְלוּ מִתְּבוּאַת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא׃
verses.english: And the mahn The miraculous food sent by God in Exod. 16:14, which sustained the Israelites in the wilderness. Trad. English “manna.” ceased on the morrow, when they ate the yield of the land;there was no more mahn for the Children of Israel,and they ate from the produce of the land of Canaan in that year.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּירִיחוֹ וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ עֹמֵד לְנֶגְדּוֹ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲלָנוּ אַתָּה אִם־לְצָרֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Yehoshua was at Jericho,that he lifted up his eyes and saw:now here, a man standing opposite him,with his sword drawn in his hand!Yehoshua went toward him and said to him:Are you for us or for our foes?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי אֲנִי שַׂר־צְבָא־יְהוָה עַתָּה בָאתִי וַיִּפֹּל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה אֲדֹנִי מְדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: He said: No and lo are homonyms. ,rather, I am the commander of YHWH’s forces.Now I have come!Yehoshua flung himself on his face to the ground and bowed low,and said to him:What does my lord have to speak to his servant?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שַׁל־נַעַלְךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹמֵד עָלָיו קֹדֶשׁ הוּא וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כֵּן׃
verses.english: The commander of YHWH’s forces said to Yehoshua:Put off your sandal from your foot,for the place on which you are standing—it is holy!And Yehoshua did thus.

verses.hebrew: וִירִיחוֹ סֹגֶרֶת וּמְסֻגֶּרֶת מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין יוֹצֵא וְאֵין בָּא׃
verses.english: Now Jericho closed up and was closed-up-tight. before the Children of Israel;no one went out and no one came in.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ גִּבּוֹרֵי הֶחָיִל׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Yehoshua:See, I have given into your handJericho and her king, [and] the mighty-men of valor.

verses.hebrew: וְסַבֹּתֶם אֶת־הָעִיר כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַקֵּיף אֶת־הָעִיר פַּעַם אֶחָת כֹּה תַעֲשֶׂה שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים׃
verses.english: You are to go around the city, all the men of battle,circling the city one time;thus you are to do for six days,

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃
verses.english: while seven priests are to carry seven shofars … seventh day … seven times: Throughout the ancient Near East, this number connotes completeness and perfection. of rams ahead of the Coffer.But on the seventh day, you are to go around the city seven times Rams’ horns, which have both military and religious functions in the Bible.,while the priests sound blasts on the shofars.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּמְשֹׁךְ בְּקֶרֶן הַיּוֹבֵל בשמעכם [כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶם] אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר יָרִיעוּ כָל־הָעָם תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְנָפְלָה חוֹמַת הָעִיר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְעָלוּ הָעָם אִישׁ נֶגְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: And it shall be, at the drawing out of the ram’s horn:when you hear the sound of the shofar,that all the fighting-people are to shout a great shout,and the wall of the city will fall down from below;then the fighting-people are to go up, each one [straight] in front of him!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׂאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת יוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Yehoshua son of Nun called for the priestsand said to them:Carry the Coffer of the Covenant,while seven priests carry seven shofars of rams ahead of the Coffer of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: ויאמרו [וַיֹּאמֶר] אֶל־הָעָם עִבְרוּ וְסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וְהֶחָלוּץ יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And he said to the fighting-people:Cross over and go around the city;as for the vanguard, it shall cross over ahead of the Coffer of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כֶּאֱמֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאִים שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עָבְרוּ וְתָקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And it was, as soon as Yehoshua talked to the fighting-people,with the seven priests carrying the seven shofars of rams in the presence of YHWH,that they crossed overand sounded blasts on the shofars,with the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant going after them.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶחָלוּץ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים תקעו [תֹּקְעֵי] הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְהַמְאַסֵּף הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הָאָרוֹן הָלוֹךְ וְתָקוֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃
verses.english: Now the vanguard was going ahead of the priests, those sounding blasts [on] the shofars,while the gathering-up [unit] was going after the Coffer, going and sounding blasts on the shofars.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָעָם צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר לֹא תָרִיעוּ וְלֹא־תַשְׁמִיעוּ אֶת־קוֹלְכֶם וְלֹא־יֵצֵא מִפִּיכֶם דָּבָר עַד יוֹם אָמְרִי אֲלֵיכֶם הָרִיעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶם׃
verses.english: As for the fighting-people, Yehoshua commanded them, saying:You are not to shout, you are not to make your voice heard,not a word is to go out of your mouthuntil the time of my saying to you: Shout!Then you are to shout.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב אֲרוֹן־יְהוָה אֶת־הָעִיר הַקֵּף פַּעַם אֶחָת וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּלִינוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: He had the Coffer of YHWH go around the city,circling one time;then they came back to the campand spent the night in the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Yehoshua started early in the morning,and the priests carried up the Coffer of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאִים שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיֹּבְלִים לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה הֹלְכִים הָלוֹךְ וְתָקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם וְהַמְאַסֵּף הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה הולך [הָלוֹךְ] וְתָקוֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃
verses.english: while the seven priests carrying the seven shofars of rams ahead of the Coffer of YHWHwere going, going along and sounding blasts on the shofars,with the vanguard going ahead of themand with the gathering-up [unit] going ahead of the Coffer of YHWH,going along and sounding blasts on the shofars.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי פַּעַם אַחַת וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּחֲנֶה כֹּה עָשׂוּ שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים׃
verses.english: They went around the city on the second day, one time,and then they returned to the camp.Thus they did for six days.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים רַק בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא סָבְבוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃
verses.english: Now it was, on the seventh day,that they started early, at the coming up of dawn;they went around the city in this manner seven times—only on this day did they go around the city seven times.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּפַּעַם הַשְּׁבִיעִית תָּקְעוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם הָרִיעוּ כִּי־נָתַן יְהוָה לָכֶם אֶת־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: And it was, at the seventh time,that the priests sounded blasts on the shofars,and Yehoshua said to the fighting-people:Shout!For YHWH has given you the city!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה הָעִיר חֵרֶם הִיא וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לַיהוָה רַק רָחָב הַזּוֹנָה תִּחְיֶה הִיא וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבַּיִת כִּי הֶחְבְּאַתָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלָחְנוּ׃
verses.english: The city will be devoted-to-destruction,it and all who are in it, for YHWH;only Rahav the whore shall live,she and all who are with her in the house,for she hid the messengers whom we sent.

verses.hebrew: וְרַק־אַתֶּם שִׁמְרוּ מִן־הַחֵרֶם פֶּן־תַּחֲרִימוּ וּלְקַחְתֶּם מִן־הַחֵרֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחֵרֶם וַעֲכַרְתֶּם אוֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: And you, only be careful regarding the devoted-things,lest you feel desire) here; more likely is the root h-m-d (the “covet” or “desire” of the tenth commandment), as reflected in LXX. The letters resh and dalet are easily confused in Hebrew script, and the switching of two adjacent letters (dalet and mem) is a common scribal error, termed metathesis. and take from the devoted-thingsand render the camp of Israel devoted-to-destruction,and bring disaster upon it.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַיהוָה אוֹצַר יְהוָה יָבוֹא׃
verses.english: For all silver and gold and vessels of bronze and iron—they are holy to YHWH;into the treasury of YHWH they are to come!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרַע הָעָם וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשֹּׁפָרוֹת וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וַיָּרִיעוּ הָעָם תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיַּעַל הָעָם הָעִירָה אִישׁ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: So the fighting-people shouted and sounded blasts on the shofars;and it was, at the people’s hearing the shofar sound,that the people shouted a great shout,and the wall fell down from below,and the people went up to the city, each one [straight] in front of him,and captured the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן וְעַד שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה וַחֲמוֹר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃
verses.english: And they devoted-to-destruction everyone who was in the city,from man to woman, from young lad to old man,to ox and sheep and donkey,with the mouth of the sword.

verses.hebrew: וְלִשְׁנַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְרַגְּלִים אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֹּאוּ בֵּית־הָאִשָּׁה הַזּוֹנָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ מִשָּׁם אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּם לָהּ׃
verses.english: But to the two men, those spying out the land, Yehoshua said:Go to the house of the whore womanand bring out from there the woman and all who belong to her,as you swore to her.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַנְּעָרִים הַמְרַגְּלִים וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֶת־רָחָב וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ וְאֶת־אִמָּהּ וְאֶת־אַחֶיהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ וְאֵת כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֶיהָ הוֹצִיאוּ וַיַּנִּיחוּם מִחוּץ לְמַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So the lads, the spies, wentand brought out Rahav and her father and her mother and her brothers and all who belonged to her—all her clan they brought out—and they placed them outside the camp of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ רַק הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וּכְלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְהַבַּרְזֶל נָתְנוּ אוֹצַר בֵּית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: As for the city, they burned it with fire, along with everything that was in it;only the silver and the gold and the vessels of bronze and iron did they place in the treasury of the house of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־רָחָב הַזּוֹנָה וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ הֶחֱיָה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הֶחְבִּיאָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: As for Rahav the whore, and her Father’s House, and all who belonged to her, Yehoshua let [them] live;she settled in the midst of Israel, until this day,for she had hid the messengers whom Yehoshua had sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁבַּע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יָקוּם וּבָנָה אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ בִּבְכֹרוֹ יְיַסְּדֶנָּה וּבִצְעִירוֹ יַצִּיב דְּלָתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua had [an oath] sworn at that time, saying:Doomed be the man before YHWHwho arises and rebuilds this city, Jericho:with his firstborn he will found it,and with his youngest he will set up its doors!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְהִי שָׁמְעוֹ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And YHWH was with Yehoshua,and report of him went throughout all the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וַיִּקַּח עָכָן בֶּן־כַּרְמִי בֶן־זַבְדִּי בֶן־זֶרַח לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה מִן־הַחֵרֶם וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But the Children of Israel committed sacrilege, yes, sacrilege regarding the devoted-things:Akhan trad. English “Achan.” son of Carmi son of Zavdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took from the devoted-things,and the anger of YHWH flared up against the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֲנָשִׁים מִירִיחוֹ הָעַי אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית אָוֶן מִקֶּדֶם לְבֵית־אֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ וְרַגְּלוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֶת־הָעָי׃
verses.english: Meanwhile, Yehoshua sent men from Jericho to Ai/The Ruin, which is beside Bet-Aven, east of Bet-El,and said to them, saying:Go up and spy out the land.So the men went up and spied out Ai;

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַל־יַעַל כָּל־הָעָם כְּאַלְפַּיִם אִישׁ אוֹ כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ יַעֲלוּ וְיַכּוּ אֶת־הָעָי אַל־תְּיַגַּע־שָׁמָּה אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם כִּי מְעַט הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: then they returned to Yehoshua and said to him:Not all the fighting-people need go up.Let about two thousand men or three thousand men go up and strike Ai—do not exhaust all the fighting-people there, for they are few.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִן־הָעָם שָׁמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ לִפְנֵי אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃
verses.english: So there went up there, from the fighting-people, about three thousand men,but they fled from before the men of Ai:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ מֵהֶם אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה אִישׁ וַיִּרְדְּפוּם לִפְנֵי הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַשְּׁבָרִים וַיַּכּוּם בַּמּוֹרָד וַיִּמַּס לְבַב־הָעָם וַיְהִי לְמָיִם׃
verses.english: the men of Ai struck down of them about thirty-six menand pursued them in front of the gate, to the Broken-Places;they struck them at the descent,and the heart of the fighting-people melted [in fear] and turned to water.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה עַד־הָעֶרֶב הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ עָפָר עַל־רֹאשָׁם׃
verses.english: Yehoshua tore his clothesand flung himself on his face on the ground before the Coffer of YHWH, until sunset, he and the elders of Israel,and they tossed earth on their heads.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לָמָה הֵעֲבַרְתָּ הַעֲבִיר אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לָתֵת אֹתָנוּ בְּיַד הָאֱמֹרִי לְהַאֲבִידֵנוּ וְלוּ הוֹאַלְנוּ וַנֵּשֶׁב בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said:Alas, YHWH God,why did you bring this people across, yes, across the Jordan,to give us into the hand of the Amorite, to have us perish?Would that we had resolved that we should stay across the Jordan!

verses.hebrew: בִּי אֲדֹנָי מָה אֹמַר אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹרֶף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבָיו׃
verses.english: Please, O my Lord,what can I say after Israel has turned the back-of-its-neck to its enemies?

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁמְעוּ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְנָסַבּוּ עָלֵינוּ וְהִכְרִיתוּ אֶת־שְׁמֵנוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּמַה־תַּעֲשֵׂה לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל׃
verses.english: When the Cannanites hear, along with all the settled-folk of the land,they will reverse course against us and cut off our name from the earth—then what will you do about your great name?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ קֻם לָךְ לָמָּה זֶּה אַתָּה נֹפֵל עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Yehoshua:Arise;now why are you fallen on your face?

verses.hebrew: חָטָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם עָבְרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אוֹתָם וְגַם לָקְחוּ מִן־הַחֵרֶם וְגַם גָּנְבוּ וְגַם כִּחֲשׁוּ וְגַם שָׂמוּ בִכְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Israel has sinned:yes builds up the effect of the crime in a wave of sound. , they have crossed my covenant that I commanded them,yes, they have taken from the devoted-things,yes, they have stolen,yes, they have lied,yes, they have put it among their vessels!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יֻכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקוּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם עֹרֶף יִפְנוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּי הָיוּ לְחֵרֶם לֹא אוֹסִיף לִהְיוֹת עִמָּכֶם אִם־לֹא תַשְׁמִידוּ הַחֵרֶם מִקִּרְבְּכֶם׃
verses.english: So the Children of Israel will not be able to rise before their enemies;the back-of-the-neck they will turn to their enemies,for they have become liable-to-destruction—I will not continue to be with youif you do not wipe out the devoted-things from your midst!

verses.hebrew: קֻם קַדֵּשׁ אֶת־הָעָם וְאָמַרְתָּ הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ לְמָחָר כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֵרֶם בְּקִרְבְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תוּכַל לָקוּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ עַד־הֲסִירְכֶם הַחֵרֶם מִקִּרְבְּכֶם׃
verses.english: Arise, hallow the people—you are to say:Hallow yourselves for tomorrow,for thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:Devoted-things are in your midst, O Israel;you will not be able to stand before your enemiesuntil your removing the devoted-things from your midst!

verses.hebrew: וְנִקְרַבְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְהָיָה הַשֵּׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ יְהוָה יִקְרַב לַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָה אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶנָּה יְהוָה תִּקְרַב לַבָּתִּים וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ יְהוָה יִקְרַב לַגְּבָרִים׃
verses.english: You are to come near in the morning by your tribes,and it shall be: the tribe that YHWH captures-by-lot) frequently used in the book to indicate conquest.shall come near by clans;and the clan that YHWH capturesshall come near by houses;and the house that YHWH capturesshall come near by the males.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנִּלְכָּד בַּחֵרֶם יִשָּׂרֵף בָּאֵשׁ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ כִּי עָבַר אֶת־בְּרִית יְהוָה וְכִי־עָשָׂה נְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And it shall be: the one captured-by-lot regarding the devoted-things is to be burned with fire,he and all who belong to him,because he crossed the covenant of YHWH,because he did a vile-thing) used to describe a terrible deed, often (but not necessarily) rape (see Gen. 34:7). in Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבָטָיו וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua started early in the morning;he brought Israel near, by their tribes,and the tribe of Judah was captured-by-lot.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֵת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי לַגְּבָרִים וַיִּלָּכֵד זַבְדִּי׃
verses.english: He brought near the clans of Judah,and the Zarhite clan was captured;he brought near the Zarhite clans, by the males, and Zavdi was captured;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ לַגְּבָרִים וַיִּלָּכֵד עָכָן בֶּן־כַּרְמִי בֶן־זַבְדִּי בֶּן־זֶרַח לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: he brought near his house, by the males,and Akhan son of Carmi son of Zavdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was captured.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־עָכָן בְּנִי שִׂים־נָא כָבוֹד לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֶן־לוֹ תוֹדָה וְהַגֶּד־נָא לִי מֶה עָשִׂיתָ אַל־תְּכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said to Akhan:My son, now give glory to YHWH, the God of Israel,and make confession to him;now tell me: What have you done?Do not conceal it from me!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן עָכָן אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמַר אָמְנָה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת עָשִׂיתִי׃
verses.english: Akhan answered Yehoshua and said:In truth, I did sin against YHWH, the God of Israel;like this and like that I did:

verses.hebrew: ואראה [וָאֵרֶא] בַשָּׁלָל אַדֶּרֶת שִׁנְעָר אַחַת טוֹבָה וּמָאתַיִם שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף וּלְשׁוֹן זָהָב אֶחָד חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים מִשְׁקָלוֹ וָאֶחְמְדֵם וָאֶקָּחֵם וְהִנָּם טְמוּנִים בָּאָרֶץ בְּתוֹךְ הָאָהֳלִי וְהַכֶּסֶף תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: I saw among the spoils a goodly Shin’ar mantle, and two hundred weights of silver,and an ingot, “tongue.” of gold, fifty weights its weight;I desired them and I took them—and here they are, hidden) is hidden in Akhan’s own name (’-k-n)! (Hawk 2000). in the ground, within my tent, along with the silver beneath it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַלְאָכִים וַיָּרֻצוּ הָאֹהֱלָה וְהִנֵּה טְמוּנָה בְּאָהֳלוֹ וְהַכֶּסֶף תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua sent messengers;they ran to the tent,and here, [it was] hidden in his tent, with the silver beneath it!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחוּם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל וַיְבִאוּם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶל כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּצִּקֻם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: They took them from amid the tent and brought them to Yehoshua and to all the Children of Israel,and they emptied them out in the presence of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח וְאֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הָאַדֶּרֶת וְאֶת־לְשׁוֹן הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת־שׁוֹרוֹ וְאֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וְאֶת־צֹאנוֹ וְאֶת־אָהֳלוֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם עֵמֶק עָכוֹר׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua took Akhan son of Zerahand the silver, and the mantle, and the ingot of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his ox, and his donkey, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that belonged to him,—all Israel was with him—and they brought them up to the Valley of Akhor/Disaster.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מֶה עֲכַרְתָּנוּ יַעְכֳּרְךָ יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶבֶן וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּסְקְלוּ אֹתָם בָּאֲבָנִים׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said:How you have brought-disaster-on us!YHWH will bring-disaster-on you this day!And all Israel pelted him with stones;they burned them with fireand stone-heaped them with stones,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקִימוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשָׁב יְהוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא עֵמֶק עָכוֹר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: and erected over him a large mound of stones, until this day.So YHWH turned back from his flaming anger.Therefore the name of that place is called the Valley of Disaster, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא וְאַל־תֵּחָת קַח עִמְּךָ אֵת כָּל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה וְקוּם עֲלֵה הָעָי רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ וְאֶת־עִירוֹ וְאֶת־אַרְצוֹ׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Yehoshua:Do not be frightened, do not be dismayed;take all the people of battle with youand arise, go up to Ai.See: I have given into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land!

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לָעַי וּלְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לִירִיחוֹ וּלְמַלְכָּהּ רַק־שְׁלָלָהּ וּבְהֶמְתָּהּ תָּבֹזּוּ לָכֶם שִׂים־לְךָ אֹרֵב לָעִיר מֵאַחֲרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: You are to do to Ai and to its kingas you did to Jericho and to its king;only its spoils and its animals may you plunder for yourselves.Set yourself an ambush for the city, behind it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה לַעֲלוֹת הָעָי וַיִּבְחַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לָיְלָה׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua arose, along with all the people of battle, to go up against Ai.And Yehoshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty-men of valor,and sent them off at night;

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֹתָם לֵאמֹר רְאוּ אַתֶּם אֹרְבִים לָעִיר מֵאַחֲרֵי הָעִיר אַל־תַּרְחִיקוּ מִן־הָעִיר מְאֹד וִהְיִיתֶם כֻּלְּכֶם נְכֹנִים׃
verses.english: he charged them, saying:See: you are setting an ambush for the city, behind the city;do not go exceedingly far from the city,but all of you be ready.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי נִקְרַב אֶל־הָעִיר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֵצְאוּ לִקְרָאתֵנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְנַסְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: As for me and all the fighting-people who are with me,we will come near to the city,and it shall be:when they come out to meet us, as at the beginning,we will flee before them.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצְאוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ עַד הַתִּיקֵנוּ אוֹתָם מִן־הָעִיר כִּי יֹאמְרוּ נָסִים לְפָנֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְנַסְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: But when they come out after us, until we have drawn them away from the city,—for they will think: They are fleeing before us as at the beginning!and we flee before them—

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תָּקֻמוּ מֵהָאוֹרֵב וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת־הָעִיר וּנְתָנָהּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃
verses.english: then you are to arise from the ambushand take possession LXX has “approach” (yiggash). of the city;YHWH your God will give it into your hand!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּתָפְשְׂכֶם אֶת־הָעִיר תַּצִּיתוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ רְאוּ צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: And it will be, when you seize the city,that you are to ignite the city with fire;in accordance with the word of YHWH you are to do.See: I have charged you!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־הַמַּאְרָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בֵּין בֵּית־אֵל וּבֵין הָעַי מִיָּם לָעָי וַיָּלֶן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם׃
verses.english: Yehoshua sent them off, and they went to the [place of] ambushand stayed between Bet-El and Ai, seaward from Ai,and Yehoshua spent the night on that night amid the fighting-people.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־הָעָם וַיַּעַל הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי הָעָם הָעָי׃
verses.english: Yehoshua started early in the morning and mustered the fighting-people;then he went up, he and the elders of Israel, ahead of the fighting-people to Ai,

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הָעָם הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עָלוּ וַיִּגְּשׁוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ נֶגֶד הָעִיר וַיַּחֲנוּ מִצְּפוֹן לָעַי וְהַגַּי בינו [בֵּינָיו] וּבֵין־הָעָי׃
verses.english: while all the people for battle who were with him went up and approached, coming opposite the city,and encamped north of Ai,with a ravine between them and Ai.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח כַּחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּשֶׂם אוֹתָם אֹרֵב בֵּין בֵּית־אֵל וּבֵין הָעַי מִיָּם לָעִיר׃
verses.english: He took about five thousand menand set them in ambush between Bet-El and Ai, seaward of the city,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן לָעִיר וְאֶת־עֲקֵבוֹ מִיָּם לָעִיר וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵמֶק׃
verses.english: while the fighting-people for MT ha-’emek (“the valley”). set up the entire camp that was north of the city,as well as its rearguard, seaward of the city.And Yehoshua lodged that night in the middle of the valley.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת מֶלֶךְ־הָעַי וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־הָעִיר לִקְרַאת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּלְחָמָה הוּא וְכָל־עַמּוֹ לַמּוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הָעֲרָבָה וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע כִּי־אֹרֵב לוֹ מֵאַחֲרֵי הָעִיר׃
verses.english: Now it was, when the king of Ai saw,that they went quickly and started-early, and the men of the city came out to meet Israel in battle,he and all his fighting-people, to the appointed place in front of the plain—but he did not know that there was an ambush for him behind the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגְעוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּנֻסוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua and all the fighting-people acted as if beaten before them;they fled by way of the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזָּעֲקוּ כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בעיר [בָּעַי] לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּנָּתְקוּ מִן־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: Then all the fighting-people who were in the city were summoned to pursue after them,and they pursued after Yehoshua and let themselves be torn away from the city,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ בָּעַי וּבֵית אֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָצְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הָעִיר פְּתוּחָה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: so that not a man remained in Ai or in Bet-El who had not gone out after Israel;they left the city openand pursued after Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ נְטֵה בַּכִּידוֹן אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדְךָ אֶל־הָעַי כִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וַיֵּט יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּכִּידוֹן אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדוֹ אֶל־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: Then YHWH said to Yehoshua:Stretch out the scimitar that is in your hand toward Ai,for into your hand I give it!So Yehoshua stretched out the scimitar that was in his hand toward the city,

verses.hebrew: וְהָאוֹרֵב קָם מְהֵרָה מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וַיָּרוּצוּ כִּנְטוֹת יָדוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּצִּיתוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: and the ambush quickly arose from its placeand ran, at the stretching out of his hand;they came to the city and captured it,and quickly ignited the city with fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עָלָה עֲשַׁן הָעִיר הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהֶם יָדַיִם לָנוּס הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהָעָם הַנָּס הַמִּדְבָּר נֶהְפַּךְ אֶל־הָרוֹדֵף׃
verses.english: The men of Ai faced about behind them and saw:now here, the smoke of the city went up to the heavens!But they had no [place] at hand to flee to here or to there.And the fighting-people who had fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי־לָכַד הָאֹרֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְכִי עָלָה עֲשַׁן הָעִיר וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃
verses.english: Now Yehoshua and all Israel sawthat the ambush had taken the city,and that the smoke of the city was going up,so they returned and struck down the men of Ai.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר לִקְרָאתָם וַיִּהְיוּ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּתָּוֶךְ אֵלֶּה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה מִזֶּה וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד וּפָלִיט׃
verses.english: These went out of the city to meet them,and they were, regarding Israel, in the middle: these were on this-side and those were on that-side,and they struck them downuntil they left them no survivor or fugitive.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּפְשׂוּ חָי וַיַּקְרִבוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃
verses.english: As for the king of Ai, they seized [him] aliveand brought him near to Yehoshua.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לַהֲרֹג אֶת־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעַי בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּם בּוֹ וַיִּפְּלוּ כֻלָּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־תֻּמָּם וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעַי וַיַּכּוּ אֹתָהּ לְפִי־חָרֶב׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Israel had finished killing all of the settled-folk of Ai, in the open-field and in the wilderness where they had pursued them,—all of them fell by the mouth of the sword, until they were gone—that all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the mouth of the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָל־הַנֹּפְלִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃
verses.english: And all those falling on that day, from man to woman,were twelve thousand, all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָטָה בַּכִּידוֹן עַד אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרִים אֵת כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעָי׃
verses.english: Now Yehoshua did not turn back his hand with which he had stretched out the scimitaruntil he had devoted-to-destruction all the settled-folk of Ai.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הַהִיא בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃
verses.english: Only the animals and the spoils of that city did Israel plunder for themselves,in accordance with the word of YHWH which he had commanded Yehoshua.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂרֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָי וַיְשִׂימֶהָ תֵּל־עוֹלָם שְׁמָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua burned down Ai;he made it into an everlasting mound, a wasteland, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּלָה עַל־הָעֵץ עַד־עֵת הָעָרֶב וּכְבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ מִן־הָעֵץ וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אוֹתָהּ אֶל־פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיָּקִימוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: As for the king of Ai, he hung him on a wooden-stake, until the time of sunset,and when the sun came in, Yehoshua commanded that they take his corpse down from the stake,and they threw it by the entrance to the city gateand erected over it a large mound of stones, until this day.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִבְנֶה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר עֵיבָל׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua built a sacrificial-altar to YHWH, the God of Israel, on Mount Eval trad. English “Ebal,” the northern of the two large hills which overlook the city of Shekhem (modern Nablus). The other was Mount Gerizim, mentioned in v.33 below.,

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵנִיף עֲלֵיהֶן בַּרְזֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה וַיִּזְבְּחוּ שְׁלָמִים׃
verses.english: as Moshe, the servant of YHWH, had commanded the Children of Israel,as is written in the Record of the Instruction of Moshe,an altar of complete stones, upon which no iron had been raised,and they sent up upon it offerings-up to YHWH,and sacrificed shalom-offerings-offerings: Scholars disagree about the meaning of Heb. shelamim. Some see the sacrifice as a “gift-of-greeting,” others as a “peace-offering”; equally possible is a “sacrifice of solidarity,” since the shelamim usually involve a sacred meal. I have kept shalom (peace, greeting, wholeness), to leave all of these possibilities open..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתָּב־שָׁם עַל־הָאֲבָנִים אֵת מִשְׁנֵה תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And he wrote there upon the stonesa copy of the Instruction of Moshe,which he had written before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּזְקֵנָיו וְשֹׁטְרִים וְשֹׁפְטָיו עֹמְדִים מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לָאָרוֹן נֶגֶד הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח חֶצְיוֹ אֶל־מוּל הַר־גְּרִזִים וְהַחֶצְיוֹ אֶל־מוּל הַר־עֵיבָל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרִאשֹׁנָה׃
verses.english: Now all Israel and its elders and its officials and its judges were standing on this-side and on that-side,by the Coffer, opposite the Levitical priests, those carrying the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant:as the sojourner, so the citizen,half of them opposite Mount Gerizim and half of them opposite Mount Eval,as Moshe, the servant of YHWH, had commanded [them] to bless the people of Israel at the beginning.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן קָרָא אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה כְּכָל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה׃
verses.english: After that, he read aloud all the words of the Instruction, the blessing and the curse,exactly as was written in the Record of the Instruction.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־קָרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ נֶגֶד כָּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְהַגֵּר הַהֹלֵךְ בְּקִרְבָּם׃
verses.english: There was not a word from all that Moshe had commandedthat Yehoshua did not read aloud opposite the entire assembly of Israel,and the women, and the little-ones, and the sojourner who was going in their midst.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ כָּל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בָּהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְכֹל חוֹף הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל אֶל־מוּל הַלְּבָנוֹן הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃
verses.english: Now it was, when all the kings who were across the Jordan heard—in the highlands and in the lowlands, and on all the shore of the Great Sea, opposite the Levanon,the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivvites, and the Yevusites—,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ יַחְדָּו לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל פֶּה אֶחָד׃
verses.english: that they gathered together to do battle with Yehoshua and with Israel, [under] one command.

verses.hebrew: וְיֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן שָׁמְעוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לִירִיחוֹ וְלָעָי׃
verses.english: But the settled-folk of Giv’on trad. English “Gibeon.” heard about what Yehoshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גַם־הֵמָּה בְּעָרְמָה וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיִּצְטַיָּרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ שַׂקִּים בָּלִים לַחֲמוֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹאדוֹת יַיִן בָּלִים וּמְבֻקָּעִים וּמְצֹרָרִים׃
verses.english: so they acted, for their part, with cunning, and went and supplied themselves:they took worn-out sacks on their donkeys,and worn-out wineskins, split and sewn up,

verses.hebrew: וּנְעָלוֹת בָּלוֹת וּמְטֻלָּאוֹת בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם וּשְׂלָמוֹת בָּלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם וְכֹל לֶחֶם צֵידָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה נִקֻּדִים׃
verses.english: with worn-out and patched sandals on their feet,and worn-out clothes upon themselves,while all the bread of their supplies was dry [and] had become crumbs.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו וְאֶל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה בָּאנוּ וְעַתָּה כִּרְתוּ־לָנוּ בְרִית׃
verses.english: And they went to Yehoshua, to the camp at Gilgal,and said to him and to the men of Israel:From a far-off land we have come;so-now, cut a covenant with us!

verses.hebrew: ויאמרו [וַיֹּאמֶר] אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַחִוִּי אוּלַי בְּקִרְבִּי אַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב וְאֵיךְ אכרות־[אֶכְרָת־] לְךָ בְרִית׃
verses.english: The men of Israel said to the Hivvites:Perhaps you are settled in my midst,so how can I cut a covenant with you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנָחְנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִי אַתֶּם וּמֵאַיִן תָּבֹאוּ׃
verses.english: They said to Yehoshua:We are your servants!Yehoshua said to them:Who are you, and from where have you come?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה מְאֹד בָּאוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי־שָׁמַעְנוּ שָׁמְעוֹ וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּמִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: They said to him:From a land exceedingly far off your servants have come,because of the fame of YHWH your God,for we have heard the heard-report of himand of all that he did in Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃
verses.english: and of all that he did to the two Amorite kings who were across the Jordan,to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan who was at Ashtarot.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ זְקֵינֵינוּ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי אַרְצֵנוּ לֵאמֹר קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם צֵידָה לַדֶּרֶךְ וּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֲלֵיהֶם עַבְדֵיכֶם אֲנַחְנוּ וְעַתָּה כִּרְתוּ־לָנוּ בְרִית׃
verses.english: So our elders and all the settled-folk of our land said to us, saying:Take in your hand supplies for the way,and go meet themand say to them:We are your servants.So-now, cut a covenant with us!

verses.hebrew: זֶה לַחְמֵנוּ חָם הִצְטַיַּדְנוּ אֹתוֹ מִבָּתֵּינוּ בְּיוֹם צֵאתֵנוּ לָלֶכֶת אֲלֵיכֶם וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָבֵשׁ וְהָיָה נִקֻּדִים׃
verses.english: This our bread—[while it was] warm, we supplied ourselves with it, from our houses,on the day of our setting out to go to you,but now, here, it is dry [and] has become crumbs!

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה נֹאדוֹת הַיַּיִן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאנוּ חֲדָשִׁים וְהִנֵּה הִתְבַּקָּעוּ וְאֵלֶּה שַׂלְמוֹתֵינוּ וּנְעָלֵינוּ בָּלוּ מֵרֹב הַדֶּרֶךְ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And these wineskins that we filled new:here, they have split open;and these our clothes and our sandals have worn outfrom this very great journey

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מִצֵּידָם וְאֶת־פִּי יְהוָה לֹא שָׁאָלוּ׃
verses.english: The men took from their supplies, but did not inquire of YHWH’s mouth.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שָׁלוֹם וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית לְחַיּוֹתָם וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ לָהֶם נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua made peace with them:he cut a covenant with them, letting them live,and the exalted-leaders of the community swore [an oath] to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־כָּרְתוּ לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כִּי־קְרֹבִים הֵם אֵלָיו וּבְקִרְבּוֹ הֵם יֹשְׁבִים׃
verses.english: But it was, at the end of three days after they had cut a covenant with them,that they heard that they [dwelt] near to them,and that it was in their midst that they were settled!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עָרֵיהֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְעָרֵיהֶם גִּבְעוֹן וְהַכְּפִירָה וּבְאֵרוֹת וְקִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃
verses.english: So the Children of Israel marched out and came to their towns on the third day—now their towns were Giv’on and Kefira and Be’erot and Kiryat-Ye’arim.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הִכּוּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלֹּנוּ כָל־הָעֵדָה עַל־הַנְּשִׂיאִים׃
verses.english: But the Children of Israel did not strike them down, since the leaders of the community had sworn to them by YHWH, the God of Israel,so the entire community grumbled) is otherwise used mainly in the rebellion stories of the book of Numbers, beginning with Chap. 11. against the leaders.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָל־הַנְּשִׂיאִים אֶל־כָּל־הָעֵדָה אֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ לָהֶם בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה לֹא נוּכַל לִנְגֹּעַ בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: And all the leaders said to the entire community:We ourselves swore to them by YHWH, the God of Israel,so now we are not able to harm them!

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם וְהַחֲיֵה אוֹתָם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה עָלֵינוּ קֶצֶף עַל־הַשְּׁבוּעָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ לָהֶם׃
verses.english: This [is how] we must act toward them:let them live,that there not be fury against us regarding the sworn-oath that we swore to them!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים יִחְיוּ וַיִּהְיוּ חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי־מַיִם לְכָל־הָעֵדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ לָהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים׃
verses.english: And the leaders said to them:They may live.So they became hewers of wood and drawers of water for the entire community,as the leaders had spoken concerning them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר לָמָּה רִמִּיתֶם אֹתָנוּ לֵאמֹר רְחוֹקִים אֲנַחְנוּ מִכֶּם מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ יֹשְׁבִים׃
verses.english: But Yehoshua called for them and spoke to them, saying:Why did you deceive us, saying:We are exceedingly far from you,when you are settled in our midst?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲרוּרִים אַתֶּם וְלֹא־יִכָּרֵת מִכֶּם עֶבֶד וְחֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי־מַיִם לְבֵית אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: So-now, doomed are you:never shall a servant be cut off has a broad range of meanings, also including “vassal,” “slave,” and “worshipper” of a deity. from youeither as hewers of wood or drawers of water for the house of my God!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמְרוּ כִּי הֻגֵּד הֻגַּד לַעֲבָדֶיךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ וּלְהַשְׁמִיד אֶת־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וַנִּירָא מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וַנַּעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: They answered Yehoshua and said:It was because it was told, yes, told to your servantsthat YHWH your God had commanded Moshe his servantto give you all the landand to wipe out all the settled-folk of the land before you—so we were very afraid for our lives before you,and we did this thing.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנְנוּ בְיָדֶךָ כַּטּוֹב וְכַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָנוּ עֲשֵׂה׃
verses.english: But now, here we are in your hand;as is good, as is right in your eyes to do with us, do.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּן וַיַּצֵּל אוֹתָם מִיַּד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הֲרָגוּם׃
verses.english: So he did thus with them:he rescued them from the hand of the Children of Israel, so that they did not kill them,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לָעֵדָה וּלְמִזְבַּח יְהוָה עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר׃
verses.english: but Yehoshua made them on that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the community,and for the sacrificial-altar of YHWH, until this day,at the place that he chooses.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם כִּי־לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעַי וַיַּחֲרִימָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִירִיחוֹ וּלְמַלְכָּהּ כֵּן־עָשָׂה לָעַי וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכִי הִשְׁלִימוּ יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Adoni-Tzedek, king of Jerusalem)., heardthat Yehoshua had captured Ai, and had devoted-it-to-destruction,—as he had done to Jericho and to its king, so he had done to Ai and to its king—and that the settled-folk of Giv’on had made peace with Israeland were remaining in their midst,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד כִּי עִיר גְּדוֹלָה גִּבְעוֹן כְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַמַּמְלָכָה וְכִי הִיא גְדוֹלָה מִן־הָעַי וְכָל־אֲנָשֶׁיהָ גִּבֹּרִים׃
verses.english: he was exceedingly afraid,for Giv’on was a large city, like one of the royal cities—indeed, it was larger than Ai, and all its men were mighty ones.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶל־הוֹהָם מֶלֶךְ־חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶל־פִּרְאָם מֶלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת וְאֶל־יָפִיעַ מֶלֶךְ־לָכִישׁ וְאֶל־דְּבִיר מֶלֶךְ־עֶגְלוֹן לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: So Adoni-Tzedek king of Jerusalem sent [word]to Hoham king of Hevron. Trad. English “Hebron,” it was located about nineteen miles southwest of Jerusalem. , and to Pir’am king of Yarmut, and to Yafia king of Lakhish trad.
