English “Lachish,” the important Judean city about fifteen miles west of Hevron. It has been identified with Tell ed-Duweir. , and to Devir king of Eglon, saying:

verses.hebrew: עֲלוּ־אֵלַי וְעִזְרֻנִי וְנַכֶּה אֶת־גִּבְעוֹן כִּי־הִשְׁלִימָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Come up to me and help me,that we may strike Giv’on,for they have made peace with Yehoshua and with the Children of Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם מֶלֶךְ־חֶבְרוֹן מֶלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת מֶלֶךְ־לָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־עֶגְלוֹן הֵם וְכָל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־גִּבְעוֹן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: They gathered together and went up, the five Amorite kings—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hevron, the king of Yarmut, the king of Lakhish, and the king of Eglon,they and all their camps,and they encamped against Giv’on, and did battle with it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִבְעוֹן אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה לֵאמֹר אַל־תֶּרֶף יָדֶיךָ מֵעֲבָדֶיךָ עֲלֵה אֵלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לָּנוּ וְעָזְרֵנוּ כִּי נִקְבְּצוּ אֵלֵינוּ כָּל־מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָהָר׃
verses.english: The men of Giv’on sent [word] to Yehoshua, to the camp at Gilgal, saying:Do not let your hand slacken from your servants;come up to us quicklyand deliver us, help us,for all the kings of the Amorites, the settled-folk of the highlands, have gathered against us!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל הוּא וְכָל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ וְכֹל גִּבּוֹרֵי הֶחָיִל׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua went up from Gilgal,he and all the people of battle with him,and all the mighty-men of valor.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מֵהֶם כִּי בְיָדְךָ נְתַתִּים לֹא־יַעֲמֹד אִישׁ מֵהֶם בְּפָנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And YHWH said to Yehoshua:Do not be afraid of them,for into your hand I have given them;no man among them will be able to stand up before you!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְאֹם כָּל־הַלַּיְלָה עָלָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל׃
verses.english: Yehoshua came against them, suddenly,having gone up all night from Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהֻמֵּם יְהוָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם מַכָּה־גְדוֹלָה בְּגִבְעוֹן וַיִּרְדְּפֵם דֶּרֶךְ מַעֲלֵה בֵית־חוֹרֹן וַיַּכֵּם עַד־עֲזֵקָה וְעַד־מַקֵּדָה׃
verses.english: And YHWH panicked them before Israel,so that they struck them, a great striking-down, at Giv’on,and pursued them by way of the Bet-Horon Pass;they struck at them as far as Azeka and as far as Makkeda..

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּנֻסָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם בְּמוֹרַד בֵּית־חוֹרֹן וַיהוָה הִשְׁלִיךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם עַד־עֲזֵקָה וַיָּמֻתוּ רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר־מֵתוּ בְּאַבְנֵי הַבָּרָד מֵאֲשֶׁר הָרְגוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּחָרֶב׃
verses.english: Now it was, when they were fleeing before Israel,—they were at the descent of Bet-Horon—that YHWH threw down upon them large stones from the heavens, as far as Azeka, and they died;[there were] more who died by the stonesthan those whom the Children of Israel killed with the sword.

verses.hebrew: אָז יְדַבֵּר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לַיהוָה בְּיוֹם תֵּת יְהוָה אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁמֶשׁ בְּגִבְעוֹן דּוֹם וְיָרֵחַ בְּעֵמֶק אַיָּלוֹן׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua spoke to YHWHon the day of YHWH’s giving the Amorites before the Children of Israel;he said before the eyes of Israel:O sun, at Giv’on be still,O moon, in the Valley of Ayyalon); for poetic effect in English, one could use “be still [as stone],” were it not for the presence of stones already in the chapter. The Hebrew verb (d-m-m) can connote both silence and immobility. Ayyalon was near Bet-Horon Pass.!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדֹּם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ עָמָד עַד־יִקֹּם גּוֹי אֹיְבָיו הֲלֹא־הִיא כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר וַיַּעֲמֹד הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בַּחֲצִי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא־אָץ לָבוֹא כְּיוֹם תָּמִים׃
verses.english: So the sun was still, and the moon stood fast,until a nation was avenged on its enemies.—Is it not written in the Record of the Upright:The sun stood fast in the midst of the heavens;it did not hasten to come in as on a whole day?

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הָיָה כַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְפָנָיו וְאַחֲרָיו לִשְׁמֹעַ יְהוָה בְּקוֹל אִישׁ כִּי יְהוָה נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: There has been none like that day before it or after it,for YHWH to hearken to a man’s voice,since YHWH was fighting for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנֻסוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחָבְאוּ בַמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָה׃
verses.english: And these five kings fledand hid themselves in a cave at Makkeda.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר נִמְצְאוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים נֶחְבְּאִים בַּמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua was told, saying:The five kings have been found hiding in a cave at Makkeda!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גֹּלּוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֶל־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהַפְקִידוּ עָלֶיהָ אֲנָשִׁים לְשָׁמְרָם׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said:Roll large stones over the mouth of the cave,and assign men over it to watch them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם אַל־תַּעֲמֹדוּ רִדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְזִנַּבְתֶּם אוֹתָם אַל־תִּתְּנוּם לָבוֹא אֶל־עָרֵיהֶם כִּי נְתָנָם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃
verses.english: As for you, do not stand around—pursue after your enemies, attack-their-tail;do not allow them to come back to their cities,for YHWH your God has given them into your hand!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכּוֹתָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה־מְאֹד עַד־תֻּמָּם וְהַשְּׂרִידִים שָׂרְדוּ מֵהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר׃
verses.english: So it was, when Yehoshua and the Children of Israel had finished striking them, a very great striking-down, until they were gone,while the survivors had escaped from them and had come back to the fortified towns—

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כָל־הָעָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַקֵּדָה בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־חָרַץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאִישׁ אֶת־לְשֹׁנוֹ׃
verses.english: that all the fighting-people returned to the camp, to Yehoshua at Makkeda, safely;not a man wagged his tongue against the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְחוּ אֶת־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֵלַי אֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן־הַמְּעָרָה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua said:Open the mouth of the caveand bring out these five kings to me from the cave!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֵלָיו אֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן־הַמְּעָרָה אֵת מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־מֶלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹן אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יַרְמוּת אֶת־מֶלֶךְ לָכִישׁ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ עֶגְלוֹן׃
verses.english: They did thus:they brought out these five kings to him from the cave,the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hevron, the king of Yarmut, the king of Lakhish, the king of Eglon;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּהוֹצִיאָם אֶת־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כָּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־קְצִינֵי אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הֶהָלְכוּא אִתּוֹ קִרְבוּ שִׂימוּ אֶת־רַגְלֵיכֶם עַל־צַוְּארֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרְבוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם עַל־צַוְּארֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and it was, upon their bringing out the kings to Yehoshua,that Yehoshua called for all the fighting-men of Israel and said to the chiefs of the men of battle who had gone with him:Come near, put your feet on the necks technically is the back of the neck, as I have put in translation elsewhere. of these kings!So they came near and put their feet on their necks.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירְאוּ וְאַל־תֵּחָתּוּ חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ כִּי כָכָה יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה לְכָל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם נִלְחָמִים אוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said to them:Do not be frightened, do not be dismayed;be strong and courageous,for thus will YHWH do to all your enemies with whom you do battle!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיְמִיתֵם וַיִּתְלֵם עַל חֲמִשָּׁה עֵצִים וַיִּהְיוּ תְּלוּיִם עַל־הָעֵצִים עַד־הָעָרֶב׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua struck them down after that, and put them to death;he hung them on five stakes,and they were hung on the stakes until sunset.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת בּוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּרִידוּם מֵעַל הָעֵצִים וַיַּשְׁלִכֻם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר נֶחְבְּאוּ־שָׁם וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת עַל־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה עַד־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Now it was, at the time of the sun coming in,that Yehoshua commanded [them] and they took them down from the stakes,and they threw them into the cave where they had hidden.Then they put large stones over the mouth of the cave,[there] until this very day.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מַקֵּדָה לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הֶחֱרִם אוֹתָם וְאֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמֶלֶךְ מַקֵּדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: As for Makkeda, Yehoshua captured [it] on that day;he struck it with the mouth of the sword, along with its king,and he devoted-it-to-destruction, along with every person that was in it—he left no survivor.And he did to the king of Makkeda as he had done to the king of Jericho recounted in the text. This kind of omission is often found in biblical narrative..

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִמַּקֵּדָה לִבְנָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם־לִבְנָה׃
verses.english: Yehoshua and all Israel with him crossed over from Makkeda to Livnaand did battle with Livna.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה גַּם־אוֹתָהּ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר בָּהּ שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: And YHWH gave it too into the hand of Israel, along with its king;he struck it with the mouth of the sword,along with every person that was in it—he left in it no survivor.And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלִּבְנָה לָכִישָׁה וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua and all Israel crossed over from Livna to Lakhish;they encamped against it and did battle against it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה אֶת־לָכִישׁ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה׃
verses.english: And YHWH gave Lakhish into the hand of Israel,so that he captured it on the second day;he struck it with the mouth of the sword,along with every person who was in it,exactly as he had done to Livna.

verses.hebrew: אָז עָלָה הֹרָם מֶלֶךְ גֶּזֶר לַעְזֹר אֶת־לָכִישׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃
verses.english: Then Horam king of Gezer went up to help Lakhish,but Yehoshua and his fighting-people struck him,until he left him no survivor.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלָּכִישׁ עֶגְלֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua and all Israel with him crossed over from Lakhish to Eglon;they encamped against it and did battle with it

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֵת כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֶחֱרִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלָכִישׁ׃
verses.english: and captured it on that day.They struck it with the mouth of the sword,while every person who was in it on that day devoted-to-destruction,exactly as he had done to Lakhish.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מֵעֶגְלוֹנָה חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon toHevron, and did battle with it;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיַּכּוּהָ־לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כָּל־עָרֶיהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְעֶגְלוֹן וַיַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָהּ וְאֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ׃
verses.english: they captured itand struck it with the mouth of the sword,along with its king and all its towns and every person that was in it—he left no survivor,exactly as he had done to Eglon:he devoted-it-to-destruction, and every person who was in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ דְּבִרָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Devir, and did battle with it;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כָּל־עָרֶיהָ וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כָּל־נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֶבְרוֹן כֵּן־עָשָׂה לִדְבִרָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ׃
verses.english: he captured it along with its king and all its towns,and struck them with the mouth of the sword and devoted-to-destruction every person that was in it—he left no survivor;as he had done to Hevron, thus he did to Devir and to its king,as they had done to Livna and to its king.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֶּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה וְהָאֲשֵׁדוֹת וְאֵת כָּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וְאֵת כָּל־הַנְּשָׁמָה הֶחֱרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua struck the entire land:the highlands, the Negev, the lowlands, and the slopes,along with all of their kings—he left no survivor,while all those breathing he devoted-to-destruction,as YHWH, the God of Israel, had commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעַד־עַזָּה וְאֵת כָּל־אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְעַד־גִּבְעוֹן׃
verses.english: Yehoshua struck them from Kadesh-Barne’a, a site frequented by the Israelites during their earlier wilderness treks. It was the very southern boundary of Judah, the later Southern Kingdom. to Gaza,and all the region of Goshen and as far as Giv’on.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־אַרְצָם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פַּעַם אֶחָת כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: All these kings and their land, Yehoshua captured at one time,since YHWH, the God of Israel, was doing battle for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יוֹבָב מֶלֶךְ מָדוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ שִׁמְרוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַכְשָׁף׃
verses.english: Now it was,when Yavin king of Hatzor heard,that he sent to Yovav king of Madon and to the king of Shimron and to the king of Akhshaf,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן בָּהָר וּבָעֲרָבָה נֶגֶב כִּנֲרוֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְנָפוֹת דּוֹר מִיָּם׃
verses.english: and to the [other] kings that were in the north,in the highlands and in the plain south, the “arid” southland of Judah, as a directional term. of the Kinneret and in the lowlandsand in the Heights of Dor, toward the Sea,

verses.hebrew: הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִמִּזְרָח וּמִיָּם וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי בָּהָר וְהַחִוִּי תַּחַת חֶרְמוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: the Canaanites toward sunrise and toward the Sea,and the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Yevusites in the highlands,and the Hivvites beneath Hermon, in the region of Mitzpa.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ הֵם וְכָל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם עַם־רָב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וְסוּס וָרֶכֶב רַב־מְאֹד׃
verses.english: They went out, they and all their camps with them,an abundance of fighting-people, like the sand that is on the seashore in abundance,and horse and chariot, an exceedingly abundant [number].

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ כֹּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־מֵי מֵרוֹם לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: All these kings met;they came and encamped together at the Waters of Merom, to do battle with Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי־מָחָר כָּעֵת הַזֹּאת אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם תְּעַקֵּר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And YHWH said to Yehoshua:Do not be afraid before them,for tomorrow at this same time I myself will make all of them slain-ones before Israel;their horses you will maim,and their chariots you will burn with fire!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־מֵי מֵרוֹם פִּתְאֹם וַיִּפְּלוּ בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua came, and all the people of battle with him, against them by the Waters of Merom, suddenly,and they fell upon them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוָה בְּיַד־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּם וַיִּרְדְּפוּם עַד־צִידוֹן רַבָּה וְעַד מִשְׂרְפוֹת מַיִם וְעַד־בִּקְעַת מִצְפֶּה מִזְרָחָה וַיַּכֻּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לָהֶם שָׂרִיד׃
verses.english: YHWH gave them into the hand of Israel, and they struck themand pursued them as far as Greater Sidon and up to Misrefot-Mayim and as far as the Cleft of Mitzpe, toward sunrise—they struck them until they had left them no survivor.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ יְהוָה אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua did to them as YHWH had said to him:their horses he maimed, and their chariots he burned with fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הִכָּה בֶחָרֶב כִּי־חָצוֹר לְפָנִים הִיא רֹאשׁ כָּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua turned back at that time and captured Hatzor,while its king he struck down with the sword,for Hatzor in former-times was the head [city] of all of these kingdoms.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב הַחֲרֵם לֹא נוֹתַר כָּל־נְשָׁמָה וְאֶת־חָצוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: They struck down every person who was in it, with the mouth of the sword;he devoted-them-to-destruction—no one breathing remained—while Hatzor he burned with fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כָּל־עָרֵי הַמְּלָכִים־הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־כָּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּכֵּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב הֶחֱרִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And all the towns of these kings, along with all their kings, Yehoshua captured and struck them with the mouth of the sword;he devoted-them-to-destruction,as Moshe, the servant of YHWH, had commanded.

verses.hebrew: רַק כָּל־הֶעָרִים הָעֹמְדוֹת עַל־תִּלָּם לֹא שְׂרָפָם יִשְׂרָאֵל זוּלָתִי אֶת־חָצוֹר לְבַדָּהּ שָׂרַף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃
verses.english: However: all the towns that were standing on their mounds, Israel did not burn;only Hatzor alone did Yehoshua burn.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל שְׁלַל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַבְּהֵמָה בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק אֶת־כָּל־הָאָדָם הִכּוּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־הִשְׁמִדָם אוֹתָם לֹא הִשְׁאִירוּ כָּל־נְשָׁמָה׃
verses.english: Now all the spoils of these towns, and all the cattle, the Children of Israel plundered for themselves;only all the humans did they strike down with the mouth of the sword, until they had wiped them out—they left no one breathing.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֵן עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵסִיר דָּבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: As YHWH had commanded Moshe his servant,thus had Moshe commanded Yehoshua,and thus Yehoshua did;he did not omit a thing of all that YHWH had commanded Moshe.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הָהָר וְאֶת־כָּל־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֵת כָּל־אֶרֶץ הַגֹּשֶׁן וְאֶת־הַשְּׁפֵלָה וְאֶת־הָעֲרָבָה וְאֶת־הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹה׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua took all this land:the highlands, all the Negev, and all the region of Goshen,the lowlands, and the Plain,the highlands of Israel and its lowlands,

verses.hebrew: מִן־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעוֹלֶה שֵׂעִיר וְעַד־בַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן תַּחַת הַר־חֶרְמוֹן וְאֵת כָּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד וַיַּכֵּם וַיְמִיתֵם׃
verses.english: from Mount Halak that goes up toward Se’iras far as Baal-Gad in the Cleft of the Levanon, beneath Mount Hermon.All their kings he captured;he struck them down and put them to death.

verses.hebrew: יָמִים רַבִּים עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כָּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: For many years, conventionally “days.” See, for instance, I Sam. 1:3, mi-yamim yamima, “from year to year” (annually). Yehoshua engaged all these kings in battle.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הָיְתָה עִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִימָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלְתִּי הַחִוִּי יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־הַכֹּל לָקְחוּ בַמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: There was not a town which had concluded peace with the Children of Israelexcept for the Hivvites, the settled-folk of Giv’on;all were taken in battle.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מֵאֵת יְהוָה הָיְתָה לְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבָּם לִקְרַאת הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן הַחֲרִימָם לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת־לָהֶם תְּחִנָּה כִּי לְמַעַן הַשְׁמִידָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: For it was from YHWH, to make their heart strong-willed toward battle with Israel,in order to devote-them-to-destruction,without there being any compassion toward them;indeed, it was to wipe them out,as YHWH had commanded Moshe.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיַּכְרֵת אֶת־הָעֲנָקִים מִן־הָהָר מִן־חֶבְרוֹן מִן־דְּבִר מִן־עֲנָב וּמִכֹּל הַר יְהוּדָה וּמִכֹּל הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־עָרֵיהֶם הֶחֱרִימָם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua came at that timeand cut off the Anakites from the highlands, from Hevron, from Devir, from Anav—from all the highlands of Judah and from all the highlands of Israel;along with their towns, Yehoshua devoted-them-to-destruction.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נוֹתַר עֲנָקִים בְּאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק בְּעַזָּה בְּגַת וּבְאַשְׁדּוֹד נִשְׁאָרוּ׃
verses.english: There were no Anakites remaining in the land of the Children of Israel—only in Gaza, in Gat, and in Ashdod were they left.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְּנָהּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְנַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua took all the land,exactly as YHWH had promised to Moshe,and Yehoshua gave it as hereditary-property, has wider connotations than the generational transfer of property; it is closer to a property claim and is frequently paralleled with “share/allotment” (Hawk 2000, who suggests “legitimate share”). to Israel, according to their divisions by their tribes.And the land was quiet from war.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה הַשָּׁמֶשׁ מִנַּחַל אַרְנוֹן עַד־הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכָל־הָעֲרָבָה מִזְרָחָה׃
verses.english: Now these are the kings of the landwhom the Children of Israel struck down and of whose land they took possession,across the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Plain toward sunrise:

verses.hebrew: סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן מֹשֵׁל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְתוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who sat [enthroned] at Heshbon,ruling from Aro’er—which is by the bank of Wadi Arnon—and the middle of the wadi, and half of Gil’ad to Yabbok trad. English “Jabbok,” the tributary of the Jordan which historically separated Ammon and the Gil’ad region. the Wadi, the border of the Children of Ammon,

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲרָבָה עַד־יָם כִּנְרוֹת מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם־הַמֶּלַח מִזְרָחָה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַיְשִׁמוֹת וּמִתֵּימָן תַּחַת אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה׃
verses.english: and the Plain as far as the Sea of Kinneret, toward sunrise, and as far as the Sea of the Plain, the Sea of Salt, toward sunrise, by way of Bet-Yeshimmot,and southward). , beneath the slopes of Pisga,

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי׃
verses.english: as border-territory,[and] the territory of Og king of Bashan, from the remnant of the Refa’im/Shades refers to the spirits of dead ancestors, who in popular thinking are not only still active but quite powerful. Some scholars, on the other hand, simply understand them as huge, mighty warriors., who sat [enthroned] at Ashtarot and at Edre’i,

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֵׁל בְּהַר חֶרְמוֹן וּבְסַלְכָה וּבְכָל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד גְּבוּל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּוֹן׃
verses.english: ruling over Mount Hermon and over Salkha and over all of Bashan,as far as the border of the Geshurites and of the Maakhatites,and half of Gil’ad, [to] the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.hebrew: מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכּוּם וַיִּתְּנָהּ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה יְרֻשָּׁה לָרֻאוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: Moshe, the servant of YHWH, and the Children of Israel had struck them down,and Moshe, the servant of YHWH, had given it as a possession to the Re’uvenites, to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Menashe.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה מִבַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן וְעַד־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעֹלֶה שֵׂעִירָה וַיִּתְּנָהּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרֻשָּׁה כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם׃
verses.english: Now these are the kings of the land whom Yehoshua and the Children of Israel struck down across the Jordan, seaward,from Baal-Gad in the Levanon Cleft as far as Mount Halak that goes up toward Se’ir;Yehoshua gave it to the tribes of Israel as a possession, in accordance with their divisions,

verses.hebrew: בָּהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבָעֲרָבָה וּבָאֲשֵׁדוֹת וּבַמִּדְבָּר וּבַנֶּגֶב הַחִתִּי הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃
verses.english: in the highlands and in the lowlands, in the Plain and in the slopes-region, in the wilderness and in the Negev—the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites,the Perizzites, the Hivvites, and the Yevusites:

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ הָעַי אֲשֶׁר־מִצַּד בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Jericho, one,the king of Ai, which is beside Bet-El, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹן אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Jerusalem, one,the king of Hevron, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ יַרְמוּת אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ לָכִישׁ אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Yarmut, one,the king of Lakhish, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ עֶגְלוֹן אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ גֶּזֶר אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Eglon, one,the king of Gezer, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ דְּבִר אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ גֶּדֶר אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Devir, one,the king of Geder, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ חָרְמָה אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Horma, one,the king of Arad, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ לִבְנָה אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ עֲדֻלָּם אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Livna, one,the king of Adullam, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ מַקֵּדָה אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Makkeda, one,the king of Bet-El, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ תַּפּוּחַ אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ חֵפֶר אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Tappu’ah, one,the king of Heyfer, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ אֲפֵק אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ לַשָּׁרוֹן אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Afek, one,the king of Lasharon, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ מָדוֹן אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ חָצוֹר אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Madon, one,the king of Hatzor, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ שִׁמְרוֹן מְראוֹן אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ אַכְשָׁף אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Shimron Meron, one,the king of Akhshaf, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ תַּעְנַךְ אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ מְגִדּוֹ אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Ta’nakh, one,the king of Megiddo, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ קֶדֶשׁ אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ־יָקְנֳעָם לַכַּרְמֶל אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Kedesh, one,the king of Yokne’am at the Carmel, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ דּוֹר לְנָפַת דּוֹר אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ־גּוֹיִם לְגִלְגָּל אֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Dor in the Height of Dor, one,the king of Goyim in Gilgal, one,

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ תִּרְצָה אֶחָד כָּל־מְלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאֶחָד׃
verses.english: the king of Tirtza, one;all the kings, thirty-one.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו אַתָּה זָקַנְתָּה בָּאתָ בַיָּמִים וְהָאָרֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָה הַרְבֵּה־מְאֹד לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃
verses.english: Now Yehoshua was old, advanced in years,and YHWH said to him:You, you are old, advanced in years,but the land is left with exceedingly much to possess.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת הָאָרֶץ הַנִּשְׁאָרֶת כָּל־גְּלִילוֹת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְכָל־הַגְּשׁוּרִי׃
verses.english: This is the land that is left:all the districts of the Philistines and all the Geshurite [region],

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַשִּׁיחוֹר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי מִצְרַיִם וְעַד גְּבוּל עֶקְרוֹן צָפוֹנָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי תֵּחָשֵׁב חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הָעַזָּתִי וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִי הָאֶשְׁקְלוֹנִי הַגִּתִּי וְהָעֶקְרוֹנִי וְהָעַוִּים׃
verses.english: —from the Shihor, that is facing Egypt, as far as the territory of Ekron northward, reckoned to the Canaanites—five Philistine overlords: the Gazite and the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, the Ekronite, and the Avvites, in the south;

verses.hebrew: מִתֵּימָן כָּל־אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וּמְעָרָה אֲשֶׁר לַצִּידֹנִים עַד־אֲפֵקָה עַד גְּבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי׃
verses.english: all the land of the Canaanitesincluding from ’Ara, “cave,” and LXX “from Gaza” (reflecting me-’azza)., which belongs to the Sidonians, to Afek, to the territory of the Amorites,

verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ הַגִּבְלִי וְכָל־הַלְּבָנוֹן מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מִבַּעַל גָּד תַּחַת הַר־חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָת׃
verses.english: the Giblite region and all of the Levanon, toward the rising of the sun,from Baal-Gad beneath Mount Hermon to Levo-Hamat.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָהָר מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן עַד־מִשְׂרְפֹת מַיִם כָּל־צִידֹנִים אָנֹכִי אוֹרִישֵׁם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק הַפִּלֶהָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנַחֲלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ׃
verses.english: As for all of the settled-folk of the highlands, from the Levanon to Misrefot-Mayim—all of the Sidonians,I myself will dispossess them before the Children of Israel.Only: have it fall to Israel as hereditary-property, as I have commanded you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה חַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת בְּנַחֲלָה לְתִשְׁעַת הַשְּׁבָטִים וַחֲצִי הַשֵּׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: So-now, divide up this land as hereditary-property to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Menashe.

verses.hebrew: עִמּוֹ הָראוּבֵנִי וְהַגָּדִי לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Along with it, the Re’uvenites and the Gadites had taken their hereditary-propertythat Moshe had given them across the Jordan, toward sunrise,just as Moshe, the servant of YHWH, had given them:

verses.hebrew: מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכָל־הַמִּישֹׁר מֵידְבָא עַד־דִּיבוֹן׃
verses.english: from Aro’er which is at the shore of Wadi Arnon, and the town that is in the middle of the wadi [valley], and all the plateau of Medeva trad. English “Medaba,” an oft-conquered town in Moabite territory, it is famous as the site of much later (sixth century C.E.) church mosaics that represent the earliest known map of sites in the land of Israel. NOTE: The many place-names that follow in these chapters are given in Hebrew forms, generally without traditional English equivalents in the Notes., as far as Divon,

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל עָרֵי סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned as king in Heshbon,as far as the territory of the Children of Ammon,

verses.hebrew: וְהַגִּלְעָד וּגְבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וְכֹל הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכָל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־סַלְכָה׃
verses.english: and Gil’ad, and the territory of the Geshurites and the Maakhatites,and all of Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan, as far as Salkha,

verses.hebrew: כָּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר־מָלַךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי הוּא נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים וַיַּכֵּם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּרִשֵׁם׃
verses.english: and all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned as king in Ashtarot and in Edre’i—he was the one left of the remnant of the Shades—:Moshe had struck them and had dispossessed them,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיֵּשֶׁב גְּשׁוּר וּמַעֲכָת בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: but the Children of Israel did not dispossess the Geshurites and the Maakhatites;Geshur and Maakha have remained settled in the midst of Israel, until this day.

verses.hebrew: רַק לְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא נָתַן נַחֲלָה אִשֵּׁי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃
verses.english: Only to the tribe of Levi did he not give hereditary-property;the fire-offerings of YHWH, the God of Israel, are its hereditary-property, as he promised it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: Moshe had given to the tribe of Re’uven, according to their clans:

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכָל־הַמִּישֹׁר עַל־מֵידְבָא׃
verses.english: now the territory) that usually means “boundary, border” in Joshua. See also v.25, 18:11, and 19:18. for them wasfrom Aro’er which is at the shore of the Wadi Arnon, and the town that is in the middle of the wadi [valley], and all the plateau around Medeva,

verses.hebrew: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְכָל־עָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּישֹׁר דִּיבוֹן וּבָמוֹת בַּעַל וּבֵית בַּעַל מְעוֹן׃
verses.english: Heshbon and all its towns that are on the plateau:Divon, Bamot-Baal, and Bet-Baal Me’on,

verses.hebrew: וְיַהְצָה וּקְדֵמֹת וּמֵפָעַת׃
verses.english: Yahtza, Kedemot, and Mefaat,

verses.hebrew: וְקִרְיָתַיִם וְשִׂבְמָה וְצֶרֶת הַשַּׁחַר בְּהַר הָעֵמֶק׃
verses.english: Kiryatayim, Sivma, and Tzeret-Shahar on the mountain of the valley,

verses.hebrew: וּבֵית פְּעוֹר וְאַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה וּבֵית הַיְשִׁמוֹת׃
verses.english: Bet-Pe’or, the Pisga Slopes, and Bet-Ha-Yeshimmot:

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכָל־מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־אֱוִי וְאֶת־רֶקֶם וְאֶת־צוּר וְאֶת־חוּר וְאֶת־רֶבַע נְסִיכֵי סִיחוֹן יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: including all the towns of the plateau, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned as king in Heshbon,whom Moshe had struck along with the leaders of Midyan:Evi, Rekem, Tzur, Hur, and Reva, the chiefs of Sihon, those settled in the land,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר הַקּוֹסֵם הָרְגוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּחֶרֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: while Bil’am), as part of the negative reassessment of him in such passages as Num. 31:8, 16, Deut. 23:5–6, and Josh. 24:9–10. son of Be’or, the soothsayer, the Children of Israelkilled with the sword, in addition to their slain.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: And the border of the Children of Re’uven was the Jordan, and the bordering-territory.This was the hereditary-property of the Children of Re’uven for their clans,the towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה־גָד לִבְנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: Moshe had given to the tribe of Gad, for the Children of Gad, for their clans:

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל יַעְזֵר וְכָל־עָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד וַחֲצִי אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי רַבָּה׃
verses.english: now the territory for them was:Ya’zer and all the towns of Gil’ad, half the land of the Children of Ammon, as far as Aro’er, which faces Rabba,

verses.hebrew: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־רָמַת הַמִּצְפֶּה וּבְטֹנִים וּמִמַּחֲנַיִם עַד־גְּבוּל לִדְבִר׃
verses.english: and from Heshbon as far as Ramat Ha-Mitzpe and Betonim, and from Mahanayim as far as the territory of Lo-Devar,

verses.hebrew: וּבָעֵמֶק בֵּית הָרָם וּבֵית נִמְרָה וְסֻכּוֹת וְצָפוֹן יֶתֶר מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל עַד־קְצֵה יָם־כִּנֶּרֶת עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃
verses.english: and in the Valley, Bet-Haram, Bet-Nimra, Sukkot, and Tzafon,the remnant of the kingdoms of Sihon king of Heshbon,the Jordan and the bordering-territory, as far as the edge of the Sea of Kinneret,across the Jordan toward sunrise.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: This was the hereditary-property of the Children of Gad, for their clans,the towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי לַחֲצִי מַטֵּה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Moshe had given to the half tribe of Menashe,for the half group) is used than the usual one for “tribe” (shevet). of the Children of Menashe, according to their clans:

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מִמַּחֲנַיִם כָּל־הַבָּשָׁן כָּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן וְכָל־חַוֺּת יָאִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עִיר׃
verses.english: now their territory wasfrom Mahanayim, all of Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan,and all the tent-villages of Ya’ir that were in Bashan, sixty towns;

verses.hebrew: וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן לִבְנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לַחֲצִי בְנֵי־מָכִיר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: half of Gil’ad,Ashtarot and Edre’i, towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,to the Children of Makhir son of Menashe—to half the Children of Makhir—for their clans.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה׃
verses.english: These it was that Moshe had given-as-hereditary-property in the Plains of Moav, across the Jordan [at] Jericho, toward sunrise.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם׃
verses.english: But to the tribe of Levi, Moshe had given no hereditary-property;YHWH, the God of Israel—he is their hereditary-property,as he promised them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אוֹתָם אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now these were what the Children of Israel received-as-hereditary-property in the land of Canaan,which El’azar the priest and Yehoshua son of Nun and the heads of the Fathers of the tribes among the Children of Israel distributed-as-property to them

verses.hebrew: בְּגוֹרַל נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃
verses.english: by the lot as their hereditary-property,as YHWH had commanded by the hand of Moshefor the nine tribes and the half tribe.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלַת שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְלַלְוִיִּם לֹא־נָתַן נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹכָם׃
verses.english: For Moshe had given the hereditary-property of the two tribes and the half tribe across the Jordan,but to the Levites he had not given hereditary-property in their midst.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף שְׁנֵי מַטּוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בָּאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־עָרִים לָשֶׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם לְמִקְנֵיהֶם וּלְקִנְיָנָם׃
verses.english: For the Children of Yosef were two tribes, Menashe and Efrayim,but they had not given a portion to the Levites in the land,except for some towns to settle in and their pasture-lands for their cattle and their acquisitions.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: As YHWH had commanded Moshe, thus the Children of Israel did;so they divided up the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים עַל אֹדוֹתַי וְעַל אֹדוֹתֶיךָ בְּקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃
verses.english: The Children of Yehuda trad. English “Judah.” approached Yehoshua at Gilgal,and Calev trad. English “Caleb.” Along with Yehoshua, he was the only other optimistic spy of Num. 14. They alone survive of the generation whose lack of trust in YHWH resulted in their dying out in the wilderness, before the book of Joshua begins. son of Yefunneh the Kenizzite said to him:You yourself know the word that YHWH spoke to Moshe the man of Godregarding me and regarding you, at Kadesh-Barne’a.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי בִּשְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה אֹתִי מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וָאָשֵׁב אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר עִם־לְבָבִי׃
verses.english: Forty years old was I when Moshe the servant of YHWH sent me from Kadesh- Barne’a to spy out the land,and I brought him back word, just as was in my heart.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַי אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמִּי הִמְסִיו אֶת־לֵב הָעָם וְאָנֹכִי מִלֵּאתִי אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: But my brothers who went up with me melted the heart of the people [with fear],while I fully-followed after YHWH my God.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר אִם־לֹא הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכָה רַגְלְךָ בָּהּ לְךָ תִהְיֶה לְנַחֲלָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד־עוֹלָם כִּי מִלֵּאתָ אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: So Moshe swore on that day, saying:If the land on which your foot has tread does not become hereditary-property for you and for your children, into the ages … !since you have fully-followed after YHWH your God.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֶחֱיָה יְהוָה אוֹתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר זֶה אַרְבָּעִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מֵאָז דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: So-now, here, YHWH has kept me alive, as he promised, these forty-five years,from when YHWH spoke this word to Moshe,when Israel was going through the wilderness.And now, here, today I am eighty-five years old;

verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנִּי הַיּוֹם חָזָק כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּיוֹם שְׁלֹחַ אוֹתִי מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹחִי אָז וּכְכֹחִי עָתָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא׃
verses.english: I am still as strong todayas on the day of Moshe’s sending me—as my might was then, so my might is now for battle,for going out and for coming in.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־הָהָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אַתָּה־שָׁמַעְתָּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־עֲנָקִים שָׁם וְעָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת בְּצֻרוֹת אוּלַי יְהוָה אוֹתִי וְהוֹרַשְׁתִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So-now, give me these highlands, which YHWH promised me on that day,—for you yourself heard on that day—though Anakites are there, and great and fortified towns;perhaps YHWH will be with me, and I will dispossess them,as YHWH promised.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה לְנַחֲלָה׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua blessed himand gave Hevron to Calev son of Yefunneh as hereditary-property.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי לְנַחֲלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Therefore Hevron is hereditary-property for Calev son of Yefunneh the Kenizzite, until this day,because he was fully-true to YHWH, the God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים הוּא וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Now the name of Hevron formerly was Kiryat-Arba;he was the greatest man among the Anakites.And the land was quiet from war.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אֶל־גְּבוּל אֱדוֹם מִדְבַּר־צִן נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה תֵימָן׃
verses.english: Now the allotment for the tribe of the Children of Yehuda, for their clans, was:to the border of Edom, at the Wilderness of Tzyn, toward the south, as the rightmost edge.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁן הַפֹּנֶה נֶגְבָּה׃
verses.english: The border for them, on the south, was from the edge of the Sea of Salt, from the “tongue” that faces the south.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה וְעָלָה מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעָבַר חֶצְרוֹן וְעָלָה אַדָּרָה וְנָסַב הַקַּרְקָעָה׃
verses.english: Then as “then” rather than as “and,” to convey the running descriptive flavor of the drawing of borders. it goes out south of LXX reads “opposite” (neged). Scorpions’ Pass, and crosses over to Tzyn.Then it goes up south of Kadesh-Barne’aand crosses over to Hetzron and went up to Addar, swinging around to Karka.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר עַצְמוֹנָה וְיָצָא נַחַל מִצְרַיִם והיה [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב׃
verses.english: Then it crosses over to Atzmon and goes out to the Wadi of Egypt;and the outer-reaches of the border are at the Sea… this will be the border for you on the south.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל קֵדְמָה יָם הַמֶּלַח עַד־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִלְּשׁוֹן הַיָּם מִקְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: And the border on the east: the Sea of Salt, as far as the edge of the Jordan;and the border on the north side:from the “tongue” of the Sea, from the edge of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל בֵּית חָגְלָה וְעָבַר מִצְּפוֹן לְבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃
verses.english: Then the border goes up to Bet-Hogla, and crosses north of Bet-Arava.Then the border goes up to the Stone of Bohan son of Re’uven.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל דְּבִרָה מֵעֵמֶק עָכוֹר וְצָפוֹנָה פֹּנֶה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּל אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח לְמַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לַנָּחַל וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־מֵי־עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־עֵין רֹגֵל׃
verses.english: Then the border goes up to Devir from the Valley of Disaster and faces toward Gilgal,which is opposite Red Pass, which is south of the wadi.Then the border crosses over to the waters of the Sun Spring;its outer-reaches are at Rogel Spring.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי מִנֶּגֶב הִיא יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵי־הִנֹּם יָמָּה אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה עֵמֶק־רְפָאִים צָפֹנָה׃
verses.english: Then the border goes up the Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, passed into later Judaism (and Christianity and Islam as well) as Gehinnom or Gehenna, “Hell.” , along the shoulder of the Yevusite, on the south—that is Jerusalem.Then the border goes up to the top of the hill that faces the Ravine of Ben Hinnom, seaward,which is at the edge of the Valley of the Shades, northward.

verses.hebrew: וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל מֵרֹאשׁ הָהָר אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ וְיָצָא אֶל־עָרֵי הַר־עֶפְרוֹן וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל בַּעֲלָה הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃
verses.english: Then the border diverges from the top of the hill at the Spring of the Waters of Neftoah and goes out to the towns of Mount Efron.Then the border diverges toward Baala—that is Kiryat-Ye’arim.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִבַּעֲלָה יָמָּה אֶל־הַר שֵׂעִיר וְעָבַר אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַר־יְעָרִים מִצָּפוֹנָה הִיא כְסָלוֹן וְיָרַד בֵּית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְעָבַר תִּמְנָה׃
verses.english: Then the border swings around from Baala seaward to Mount Se’ir,and crosses to the shoulder of Mount Ye’arim, northward—that is Kesalon—and goes down to Bet-Shemesh and crosses over by Timna.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף עֶקְרוֹן צָפוֹנָה וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל שִׁכְּרוֹנָה וְעָבַר הַר־הַבַּעֲלָה וְיָצָא יַבְנְאֵל וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה׃
verses.english: Then the border goes out to the shoulder of Ekron, northward.Then the border diverges toward Shikkeron and crosses to Mount Baala.Then it goes out to Yavne’el;the outer-reaches of the border are at the Sea.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל יָם הַיָּמָּה הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶה גְּבוּל בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה סָבִיב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: And the seaward borderis the Great Sea, and the [adjacent] territory.This is the border of the Children of Yehuda, all around, for their clans.

verses.hebrew: וּלְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה נָתַן חֵלֶק בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־פִּי יְהוָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע אֲבִי הָעֲנָק הִיא חֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Now to Calev son of Yefunneh he gave a portion amid the Children of Yehuda, at YHWH’s order to Yehoshua:Kiryat-Arba, the father of the Anakites—that is Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם כָּלֵב אֶת־שְׁלוֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמַי יְלִידֵי הָעֲנָק׃
verses.english: And Calev dispossessed from there the three sons of Anak—Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, those born of Anak.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי דְּבִר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִר לְפָנִים קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר׃
verses.english: He went up from there against the settled-folk of Devir—now the name of Devir formerly was Kiryat-Sefer.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כָּלֵב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: And Calev said:The one who strikes Kiryat-Sefer and captures it,I will give him Akhsa my daughter as a wife!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ עָתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: Otniel son of Kenaz, Calev’s brother, captured it,so he gave him Akhsa trad. English “Achsah.” his daughter as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאוֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִיהָ שָׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: And it was when she came, that she induced him to request a field from her father.When she alighted from the donkey, Calev said to her:What [ails] you?

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר תְּנָה־לִּי בְרָכָה כִּי אֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב נְתַתָּנִי וְנָתַתָּה לִי גֻּלֹּת מָיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ אֵת גֻּלֹּת עִלִּיּוֹת וְאֵת גֻּלֹּת תַּחְתִּיּוֹת׃
verses.english: She said:Give me a gift-of-blessing!Indeed, you have given me arid land). JPS understands the expression as referring to Akhsa herself, namely, a woman without a dowry.;you should give me pools of water!So he gave her the Upper Pools and the Lower Pools.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: This is the hereditary-property of the tribe of the Children of Yehuda, for their clans:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הֶעָרִים מִקְצֵה לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־גְּבוּל אֱדוֹם בַּנֶּגְבָּה קַבְצְאֵל וְעֵדֶר וְיָגוּר׃
verses.english: the towns at the edge of the tribe of the Children of Yehudatoward the border of Edom, in the Negev:Kavtze’el, Eider, and Yagur,

verses.hebrew: וְקִינָה וְדִימוֹנָה וְעַדְעָדָה׃
verses.english: Kina, Dimona, and Ad’ada,

verses.hebrew: וְקֶדֶשׁ וְחָצוֹר וְיִתְנָן׃
verses.english: Kedesh and Hatzar-Yitnan,

verses.hebrew: זִיף וָטֶלֶם וּבְעָלוֹת׃
verses.english: Zif, Telem, and Be’alot,

verses.hebrew: וְחָצוֹר חֲדַתָּה וּקְרִיּוֹת חֶצְרוֹן הִיא חָצוֹר׃
verses.english: Hatzor-Hadatta and the hamlets of Hetzron—that is Hatzor,

verses.hebrew: אֲמָם וּשְׁמַע וּמוֹלָדָה׃
verses.english: Amam, Shema, and Molada,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲצַר גַּדָּה וְחֶשְׁמוֹן וּבֵית פָּלֶט׃
verses.english: Hatzar-Gadda, Heshmon, and Bet-Pelet,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבְאֵר שֶׁבַע וּבִזְיוֹתְיָה׃
verses.english: Hatzar-Shual, Be’er-Sheva, and Bizyotya, “and its daughter-towns,” a common term in these texts for “dependencies” (Boling 1982).,

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲלָה וְעִיִּים וָעָצֶם׃
verses.english: Baala, Iyyim, and Etzem,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַד וּכְסִיל וְחָרְמָה׃
verses.english: Eltolad, Kesil, and Horma,

verses.hebrew: וְצִקְלַג וּמַדְמַנָּה וְסַנְסַנָּה׃
verses.english: Tziklag, Madmanna, and Sansanna,

verses.hebrew: וּלְבָאוֹת וְשִׁלְחִים וְעַיִן וְרִמּוֹן כָּל־עָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Levaot, Shilhim, and Rimmon Spring as ’En Rimmon, “Pomegranate Spring.”—all the towns: twenty-nine, and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: בַּשְּׁפֵלָה אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל וְצָרְעָה וְאַשְׁנָה׃
verses.english: In the lowlands:Eshtaol, Tzor’a, and Ashna,

verses.hebrew: וְזָנוֹחַ וְעֵין גַּנִּים תַּפּוּחַ וְהָעֵינָם׃
verses.english: Zanoah and Gannim Spring,Tappu’ah and Enam,

verses.hebrew: יַרְמוּת וַעֲדֻלָּם שׂוֹכֹה וַעֲזֵקָה׃
verses.english: Yarmut and Adullam,Sokho and Azeka,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁעֲרַיִם וַעֲדִיתַיִם וְהַגְּדֵרָה וּגְדֵרֹתָיִם עָרִים אַרְבַּע־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Shaarayim and Aditayim,Gedera and Gederotayim—towns, fourteen, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: צְנָן וַחֲדָשָׁה וּמִגְדַּל־גָּד׃
verses.english: Tzanan, Hadasha, and Migdal Gad,

verses.hebrew: וְדִלְעָן וְהַמִּצְפֶּה וְיָקְתְאֵל׃
verses.english: Dil’am, Mitzpe, and Yokte’el,

verses.hebrew: לָכִישׁ וּבָצְקַת וְעֶגְלוֹן׃
verses.english: Lakhish, Botzkat, and Eglon,

verses.hebrew: וְכַבּוֹן וְלַחְמָס וְכִתְלִישׁ׃
verses.english: Kabbon, Lahmas, and Kitlish,

verses.hebrew: וּגְדֵרוֹת בֵּית־דָּגוֹן וְנַעֲמָה וּמַקֵּדָה עָרִים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Gedeirot, Bet-Dagon, Naama, and Makkeda—towns, sixteen, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: לִבְנָה וָעֶתֶר וְעָשָׁן׃
verses.english: Livna, Eter, and Asham,

verses.hebrew: וְיִפְתָּח וְאַשְׁנָה וּנְצִיב׃
verses.english: Yiftah, Ashna, and Netziv,

verses.hebrew: וּקְעִילָה וְאַכְזִיב וּמָרֵאשָׁה עָרִים תֵּשַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Ke’ila, Akhziv, and Maresha—towns, nine, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: עֶקְרוֹן וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וַחֲצֵרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Ekron and its daughter-towns, and its farmsteads,

verses.hebrew: מֵעֶקְרוֹן וָיָמָּה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־יַד אַשְׁדּוֹד וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: from Ekron seawardall those near Ashdod, and their farmsteads,

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁדּוֹד בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַחֲצֵרֶיהָ עַזָּה בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַחֲצֵרֶיהָ עַד־נַחַל מִצְרָיִם וְהַיָּם הגבול [הַגָּדוֹל] וּגְבוּל׃
verses.english: Ashdod, its daughter-towns and its farmsteads,Gaza, its daughter-towns and its farmsteads,as far as the Wadi of Egypt, up to the Great Sea and the border-territory;

verses.hebrew: וּבָהָר שָׁמִיר וְיַתִּיר וְשׂוֹכֹה׃
verses.english: in the highlands:Shamir, Yattir, and Sokho,

verses.hebrew: וְדַנָּה וְקִרְיַת־סַנָּה הִיא דְבִר׃
verses.english: Danna, Kiryat-Sanna—that is Devir,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲנָב וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹה וְעָנִים׃
verses.english: Anav, Eshtemo, and Anim,

verses.hebrew: וְגֹשֶׁן וְחֹלֹן וְגִלֹה עָרִים אַחַת־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Goshen, Holon, and Gilo—towns, eleven, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: אֲרַב וְרוּמָה וְאֶשְׁעָן׃
verses.english: Arav, Duma, and Esh’an,

verses.hebrew: וינים [וְיָנוּם] וּבֵית־תַּפּוּחַ וַאֲפֵקָה׃
verses.english: Yanum, Bet-Tappuah, and Afeka,

verses.hebrew: וְחֻמְטָה וְקִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן וְצִיעֹר עָרִים תֵּשַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Humta, Kiryat-Arba—that is Hevron—and Tzi’or—towns, nine, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: מָעוֹן כַּרְמֶל וָזִיף וְיוּטָּה׃
verses.english: Ma’on, Carmel, Zif, and Yutta,

verses.hebrew: וְיִזְרְעֶאל וְיָקְדְעָם וְזָנוֹחַ׃
verses.english: Yizre’el, Yokde’am, and Zanoah,

verses.hebrew: הַקַּיִן גִּבְעָה וְתִמְנָה עָרִים עֶשֶׂר וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Kayin, Giv’a, and Timna—towns, ten, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: חַלְחוּל בֵּית־צוּר וּגְדוֹר׃
verses.english: Halhul, Bet-Tzur, and Gedor,

verses.hebrew: וּמַעֲרָת וּבֵית־עֲנוֹת וְאֶלְתְּקֹן עָרִים שֵׁשׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Maarat, Bet-Anot, and Eltekon—towns, six, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: קִרְיַת־בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְהָרַבָּה עָרִים שְׁתַּיִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Kiryat-Baal—that is Kiryat-Ye’arim—and Rabba—towns, two, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: בַּמִּדְבָּר בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה מִדִּין וּסְכָכָה׃
verses.english: in the wilderness:Bet-Arava, Middin, and Sekhakha,

verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּבְשָׁן וְעִיר־הַמֶּלַח וְעֵין גֶּדִי עָרִים שֵׁשׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Nivshan, Salt City, and En-Gedi—towns, six, and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי יוֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם לֹא־יוכלו [יָכְלוּ] בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה לְהוֹרִישָׁם וַיֵּשֶׁב הַיְבוּסִי אֶת־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Now as for the Yevusites, the settled-folk of Jerusalem,the Children of Yehuda were not able to dispossess them,so the Yevusites are settled with the Children of Yehuda in Jerusalem, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף מִיַּרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ לְמֵי יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה הַמִּדְבָּר עֹלֶה מִירִיחוֹ בָּהָר בֵּית־אֵל׃
verses.english: And the allotment for the Children of Yosef trad. English “Joseph.” went out from Jordan [at] Jericho, to the waters of Jericho, toward sunrise, into the wilderness,going up from Jericho through the highlands to Bet-El.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא מִבֵּית־אֵל לוּזָה וְעָבַר אֶל־גְּבוּל הָאַרְכִּי עֲטָרוֹת׃
verses.english: Then it goes out from Bet-El to Luz,and crosses to the border of the Arkites at Atarot.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד־יָמָּה אֶל־גְּבוּל הַיַּפְלֵטִי עַד גְּבוּל בֵּית־חוֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן וְעַד־גָּזֶר וְהָיוּ תצאתו [תֹצְאֹתָיו] יָמָּה׃
verses.english: Then it goes down seaward to the border of the Yafletites, as far as the border of Lower Bet-Horon and as far as Gezer;its outer-reaches are at the Sea.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנְחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: Thus were the Children of Yosef, Menashe and Efrayim, given hereditary-property.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם מִזְרָחָה עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַד־בֵּית חוֹרֹן עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: Now the boundary of the Children of Efrayim, according to their clans, was:the border of their hereditary-property was, toward sunrise, from Atarot-Addar as far as Upper Bet-Horon.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל הַיָּמָּה הַמִּכְמְתָת מִצָּפוֹן וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִזְרָחָה תַּאֲנַת שִׁלֹה וְעָבַר אוֹתוֹ מִמִּזְרַח יָנוֹחָה׃
verses.english: Then the border goes out seaward to Mikhmetat on the north.Then the border swings around toward sunrise to Taanat Shilo,and crosses by it, sunrise to Yanoah.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד מִיָּנוֹחָה עֲטָרוֹת וְנַעֲרָתָה וּפָגַע בִּירִיחוֹ וְיָצָא הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: Then it goes down from Yanoah to Atarot and to Naara and touches Jericho, and goes out to the Jordan;

verses.hebrew: מִתַּפּוּחַ יֵלֵךְ הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה נַחַל קָנָה וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: from Tappuah the border goes seaward, to the Wadi Kama,and its outer-reaches are at the Sea.This is the hereditary-property of the Children of Efrayim, for their clans,

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה כָּל־הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: with the towns set apart for the Children of Efrayim amid the hereditary-property of the Children of Menashe,all the towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקֶרֶב אֶפְרַיִם עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי לְמַס־עֹבֵד׃
verses.english: But they were not able to dispossess the Canaanites, those settled in Gezer,so the Canaanites remained settled amid Efrayim, to this day;they became laboring serfs.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי־הוּא בְּכוֹר יוֹסֵף לְמָכִיר בְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה אֲבִי הַגִּלְעָד כִּי הוּא הָיָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃
verses.english: And the allotment for the tribe of Menashe was—since he was the firstborn of Yosef—for Makhir firstborn of Menashe, father of Gil’ad, since he was a man of battle,and Gil’ad and Bashan belonged to him [already].

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנֵי אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵלֶק וְלִבְנֵי אַשְׂרִיאֵל וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁכֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵפֶר וְלִבְנֵי שְׁמִידָע אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה בֶּן־יוֹסֵף הַזְּכָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: So it was for the rest of the Children of Menashe, according to their clans:for the Children of Avi’ezer, for the Children of Helek, for the Children of Asriel, for the Children of Shekhem, for the Children of Heyfer, for the Children of Shemida—these were the Children of Menashe son of Yosef, the males for their clans.

verses.hebrew: וְלִצְלָפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חָגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃
verses.english: Now Tzelofhad son of Heyfer son of Gil’ad son of Makhir son of Menashe—he had no sons, but rather daughters,and these were his daughters’ names:Mahla, No’a, Hogla, Milka, and Tirtza.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרַבְנָה לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִים לֵאמֹר יְהוָה צִוָּה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אַחֵינוּ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֶל־פִּי יְהוָה נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶן׃
verses.english: They came before El’azar the priest and before Yehoshua son of Nun and before the exalted-leaders, saying:YHWH commanded Moshe to give us hereditary-property amid our brothers!And they were given, by the order of YHWH, hereditary-property amid their father’s brothers.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְּלוּ חַבְלֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה עֲשָׂרָה לְבַד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: The measured-areas falling to Menashe [were] ten,aside from the land of Gil’ad and Bashan, which are across the Jordan,

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְּנוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה נָחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בָּנָיו וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הָיְתָה לִבְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים׃
verses.english: for the daughters of Menashe inherited hereditary-property amid their brothers,while the land of Gil’ad was for the rest of the Children of Menashe.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה מֵאָשֵׁר הַמִּכְמְתָת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי שְׁכֶם וְהָלַךְ הַגְּבוּל אֶל־הַיָּמִין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי עֵין תַּפּוּחַ׃
verses.english: And the border of Menashe was:from Asher to Mikhmetat, which faces Shekhem,then the border goes to the right/the south, toward Yashuv, “the settled-folk of.” [and] En Tappuah,

verses.hebrew: לִמְנַשֶּׁה הָיְתָה אֶרֶץ תַּפּוּחַ וְתַפּוּחַ אֶל־גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה לִבְנֵי אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: —belonging to Menashe was the region of Tappuah, but Tappuah is on the border of Menashe, belonging to the Children of Efrayim—

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל נַחַל קָנָה נֶגְבָּה לַנַּחַל עָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ עָרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וּגְבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִצְּפוֹן לַנַּחַל וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃
verses.english: then the border goes down to the Wadi Kana.South of the wadi, these towns belonged to Efrayim amid the towns of Menashe;the border of Menashe was north of the wadi,and all their outer-reaches are at the Sea.

verses.hebrew: נֶגְבָּה לְאֶפְרַיִם וְצָפוֹנָה לִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי הַיָּם גְּבוּלוֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר יִפְגְּעוּן מִצָּפוֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָר מִמִּזְרָח׃
verses.english: The southland belongs to Efrayim and the north belongs to Menashe, and the Sea is its border;Asher they touch on the north, and Yissakhar toward sunrise.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִמְנַשֶּׁה בְּיִשָּׂשכָר וּבְאָשֵׁר בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָם וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי דֹאר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי עֵין־דֹּר וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי תַעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַנָּפֶת׃
verses.english: There belonged to Menashe in Yissakhar and Asher:Bet-She’an and its daughter-towns, Yivle’am and its daughter-towns,along with the settled-folk of Dor and its daughter-towns,the settled-folk of En Dor and its daughter-towns, the settled-folk of Ta’nakh and its daughter-towns, and the settled-folk of Megiddo and its daughter-towns, the Three Heights.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: But the Children of Menashe were not able to dispossess these towns;the Canaanites persisted in remaining-settled in this land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי חָזְקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵשׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃
verses.english: It was, when the Children of Israel grew strong, that they put the Canaanites into forced-labor,but dispossess, they could not dispossess them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ נָתַתָּה לִּי נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל אֶחָד וְחֶבֶל אֶחָד וַאֲנִי עַם־רָב עַד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּה בֵּרְכַנִי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now the Children of Yosef spoke to Yehoshua, saying:For-what-reason have you given me as hereditary-property [only] one allotment, one area?For I am a numerous people,since until now YHWH has blessed me greatly!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אִם־עַם־רַב אַתָּה עֲלֵה לְךָ הַיַּעְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ לְךָ שָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ הַפְּרִזִּי וְהָרְפָאִים כִּי־אָץ לְךָ הַר־אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said to them:If you are [such] a numerous people,go you up into the forestand clear [ground] for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Refaites,since the highlands of Efrayim are too confining for you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לֹא־יִמָּצֵא לָנוּ הָהָר וְרֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל בְּכָל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ־הָעֵמֶק לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶאל׃
verses.english: The Children of Yosef said:There is not [enough] for us in the highlands,but iron chariots are everywhere among the Canaanites who are settled in the valley region,those in Bet-She’an and its daughter-towns and those in the Valley of Yizre’el.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁה לֵאמֹר עַם־רַב אַתָּה וְכֹחַ גָּדוֹל לָךְ לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ גּוֹרָל אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Yehoshua said to the House of Yosef, to Efrayim and to Menashe, saying:You are a numerous people,and you have great might;you shall not have [just] one allotment,

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַר יִהְיֶה־לָּךְ כִּי־יַעַר הוּא וּבֵרֵאתוֹ וְהָיָה לְךָ תֹּצְאֹתָיו כִּי־תוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי כִּי רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לוֹ כִּי חָזָק הוּא׃
verses.english: for the highlands shall be yours, since it is forest—you are to clear it, and its outer-reaches will be yours,for you will dispossess the Canaanites,though they have iron chariots,though they are strong.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה וַיַּשְׁכִּינוּ שָׁם אֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָאָרֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now the entire community of the Children of Israel assembled at Shilo, this site houses the Coffer and is thus an important religious center in the traditions of Judges and Samuel. and they set up there the Tent of Appointment,since the land was subdued before them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּתְרוּ בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָלְקוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתָם שִׁבְעָה שְׁבָטִים׃
verses.english: And there remained among the Children of Israel, whose hereditary-property had not been divided up, seven tribes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־אָנָה אַתֶּם מִתְרַפִּים לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua said to the Children of Israel:Until when will you show yourselves slackin coming, in settling the land that YHWH, the God of your Fathers, has given you?

verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לָכֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים לַשָּׁבֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵם וְיָקֻמוּ וְיִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִכְתְּבוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי נַחֲלָתָם וְיָבֹאוּ אֵלָי׃
verses.english: Provide yourselves three men per tribe, that I may send them outLet them arise and walk about in the land,that they may write it up according to their hereditary-property;then let them come back to me.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְחַלְּקוּ אֹתָהּ לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים יְהוּדָה יַעֲמֹד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ מִנֶּגֶב וּבֵית יוֹסֵף יַעַמְדוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָם מִצָּפוֹן׃
verses.english: They are to divide it among themselves into seven divisions:Judah will be situated on his territory in the Negev,while the House of Yosef will be situated on their territory in the north.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תִּכְתְּבוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֵלַי הֵנָּה וְיָרִיתִי לָכֶם גּוֹרָל פֹּה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: As for you, you are to write up the land as seven portions and have it come to me here,that I may cast the lot for you here, in the presence of YHWH our God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין־חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־כְהֻנַּת יְהוָה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְגָד וּרְאוּבֵן וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה׃
verses.english: For the Levites have no portion in your midst,since the priesthood of YHWH is their hereditary-property,and Gad, Re’uven, and the half tribe of Menashe have taken their hereditary-property across the Jordan, toward sunrise,which Moshe, the servant of God, gave them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים לִכְתֹּב אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְכִתְבוּ אוֹתָהּ וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וּפֹה אַשְׁלִיךְ לָכֶם גּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּשִׁלֹה׃
verses.english: The men arose and were about to go,and Yehoshua commanded those who were going to write up the land, saying:Go, go about through the land and write it up, and return to me;it is here that I shall cast lots for you in the presence of YHWH at Shilo.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַבְרוּ בָאָרֶץ וַיִּכְתְּבוּהָ לֶעָרִים לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים עַל־סֵפֶר וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה׃
verses.english: The men went and crossed through the land,and they wrote it up, regarding the towns, as seven portions, in a record;then they came back to Yehoshua in the camp at Shilo.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גּוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua cast lots for them at Shilo, in the presence of YHWH,and Yehoshua divided up the land there for the Children of Israel, according to their divisions.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל גּוֹרַל מַטֵּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיֵּצֵא גְּבוּל גּוֹרָלָם בֵּין בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבֵין בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף׃
verses.english: The lot came up of the tribe of the Children of Binyamin, for their clans:the territory of their allotment went out between the Children of Judah and the Children of Yosef;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף יְרִיחוֹ מִצָּפוֹן וְעָלָה בָהָר יָמָּה והיה [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאֹתָיו מִדְבַּרָה בֵּית אָוֶן׃
verses.english: the border for them, on the northern side, [starting] from the Jordan.Then the border goes up to the shoulder of Jericho on the north and goes up into the highlands, seaward;its outer-reaches are at the Wilderness of Bet-Aven.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר מִשָּׁם הַגְּבוּל לוּזָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף לוּזָה נֶגְבָּה הִיא בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַל־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לְבֵית־חֹרוֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃
verses.english: Then the border crosses from there to Luz, on the shoulder of Luz, toward the Negev—that is Bet-El.Then the border goes down toward Atarot-Addar,on the hill that faces Lower Bet-Horon.

verses.hebrew: וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל וְנָסַב לִפְאַת־יָם נֶגְבָּה מִן־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי בֵית־חֹרוֹן נֶגְבָּה והיה [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים עִיר בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה זֹאת פְּאַת־יָם׃
verses.english: Then the border diverges and swings around on the seaward side, toward the Negev, from the hill that faces Bet-Horon, toward the Negev;its outer-reaches are at Kiryat-Baal—that is Kiryat-Ye’arim, a town of the Children of Yehuda—that is the seaward side.

verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת־נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה וְיָצָא אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ׃
verses.english: And on the Negev side, from the edge of Kiryat-Ye’arim,the border goes seaward, and then goes out to the Spring of the Waters of Neftoah.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל אֶל־קְצֵה הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד גֵּי הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי נֶגְבָּה וְיָרַד עֵין רֹגֵל׃
verses.english: Then the border goes down to the edge of the hill that faces the Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, that is in the Valley of the Shades, northward.Then it goes down in the Ravine of Hinnom to the Yevusite shoulder, toward the Negev,and goes down to Rogel Spring.

verses.hebrew: וְתָאַר מִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָצָא אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח מַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים וְיָרַד אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃
verses.english: Then it diverges from the northand comes out at the Spring of the Sun.Then it goes out Gelilot, that is opposite Red Pass.Then it goes down to the Stone of Bohan son of Re’uven.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר אֶל־כֶּתֶף מוּל־הָעֲרָבָה צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד הָעֲרָבָתָה׃
verses.english: Then it crosses to the shoulder opposite the Plain, northward,and goes down to the Plain.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף בֵּית־חָגְלָה צָפוֹנָה והיה [וְהָיוּ ] תצאותיו [תֹּצְאוֹת] הַגְּבוּל אֶל־לְשׁוֹן יָם־הַמֶּלַח צָפוֹנָה אֶל־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן נֶגְבָּה זֶה גְּבוּל נֶגֶב׃
verses.english: Then the border crosses to the shoulder of Bet-Hogla, on the north;the outer-reaches of the border are at the tongue of the Sea of Salt, on the north,at the edge of the Jordan, on the south-side—that is the border on the south.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיַּרְדֵּן יִגְבֹּל־אֹתוֹ לִפְאַת־קֵדְמָה זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: And the Jordan borders it on the eastern side.This is the hereditary-property of the Children of Binyamin, for their clans, according to its borders all around, for their clans.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶם יְרִיחוֹ וּבֵית־חָגְלָה וְעֵמֶק קְצִיץ׃
verses.english: And the towns that were the tribe of the Children of Binyamin’s, for their clans, are:Jericho, Bet-Hogla, and Emek Ketzitz,

verses.hebrew: וּבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וּצְמָרַיִם וּבֵית־אֵל׃
verses.english: Bet-Arava, Tzemarayim, and Bet-El,

verses.hebrew: וְהָעַוִּים וְהַפָּרָה וְעָפְרָה׃
verses.english: Avvim, Para, and Ofra,

verses.hebrew: וּכְפַר העמני [הָעַמֹּנָה] וְהָעָפְנִי וָגָבַע עָרִים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Kefar-Ammona, Ofni, and Geva—towns, twelve, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: גִּבְעוֹן וְהָרָמָה וּבְאֵרוֹת׃
verses.english: Giv’on, Rama, and Be’erot,

verses.hebrew: וְהַמִּצְפֶּה וְהַכְּפִירָה וְהַמֹּצָה׃
verses.english: Mitzpe, Kefira, and Motza,

verses.hebrew: וְרֶקֶם וְיִרְפְּאֵל וְתַרְאֲלָה׃
verses.english: Rekem, Yirpael, and Tar’ala,

verses.hebrew: וְצֵלַע הָאֶלֶף וְהַיְבוּסִי הִיא יְרוּשָׁלִַם גִּבְעַת קִרְיַת עָרִים אַרְבַּע־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: Tzela, Elef, the Yevusite—that is Jerusalem,Giv’at and Kiryat__—towns, fourteen, and their farmsteads.This was the hereditary-property of Binyamin, for their clans.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַשֵּׁנִי לְשִׁמְעוֹן לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם וַיְהִי נַחֲלָתָם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: The second lot came out for Shim’on trad. English “Simeon.”, for the tribe of the Children of Shim’on, for their clans;their hereditary-property was amid the hereditary-property of the Children of Yehuda.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם בְּנַחֲלָתָם בְּאֵר־שֶׁבַע וְשֶׁבַע וּמוֹלָדָה׃
verses.english: They had in their hereditary-property:Be’er-Sheva, Sheva, and Molada,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבָלָה וָעָצֶם׃
verses.english: Hatzar-Shual, Bala, and Etzem,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַד וּבְתוּל וְחָרְמָה׃
verses.english: Eltolad, Betul, and Horma,

verses.hebrew: וְצִקְלַג וּבֵית־הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת וַחֲצַר סוּסָה׃
verses.english: Tziklag, Bet-Markavot, and Hatzar-Susa,

verses.hebrew: וּבֵית לְבָאוֹת וְשָׁרוּחֶן עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Bet-Levaot, and Sharuhen—towns, thirteen, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: עַיִן רִמּוֹן וָעֶתֶר וְעָשָׁן עָרִים אַרְבַּע וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Ayin, Rimmon, Eter, and Ashan—towns, four, and their farmsteads;

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר רָאמַת נֶגֶב זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: and all the farmsteads that are around these towns, as far as Baalat-Be’er, [and] Ramat Negev.This is the hereditary-property of the tribe of Shim’on, for their clans.

verses.hebrew: מֵחֶבֶל בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן כִּי־הָיָה חֵלֶק בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה רַב מֵהֶם וַיִּנְחֲלוּ בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלָתָם׃
verses.english: From the area of the Children of Yehuda was the hereditary-property of the Children of Shim’on,for the portion of the Children of Yehuda was too large for them,so the Children of Shim’on received hereditary-property amid their hereditary-property.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַגּוֹרָל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם עַד־שָׂרִיד׃
verses.english: The third lot came up for the Children of Zevulun trad. English “Zebulun.” for their clans;the border of their hereditary-property is as far as Sarid.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה גְבוּלָם לַיָּמָּה וּמַרְעֲלָה וּפָגַע בְּדַבָּשֶׁת וּפָגַע אֶל־הַנַּחַל אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יָקְנְעָם׃
verses.english: Their border goes up toward the Sea and Mar’ala, touching Dabbeshet,and touches the wadi that faces Yokne’am.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב מִשָּׂרִיד קֵדְמָה מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עַל־גְּבוּל כִּסְלֹת תָּבֹר וְיָצָא אֶל־הַדָּבְרַת וְעָלָה יָפִיעַ׃
verses.english: Then it turns from Sarid eastward, toward the rising of the sun, to the border of Kislot-Tavor,and goes out at Dav’rat, going up to Yafi’a;

verses.hebrew: וּמִשָּׁם עָבַר קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה גִּתָּה חֵפֶר עִתָּה קָצִין וְיָצָא רִמּוֹן הַמְּתֹאָר הַנֵּעָה׃
verses.english: from there it crosses eastward, toward sunrise, to Gat-Heyfer and to Et-Katzin.Then it goes out to Rimmon, diverging to Nei’a.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב אֹתוֹ הַגְּבוּל מִצְּפוֹן חַנָּתֹן וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאֹתָיו גֵּי יִפְתַּח־אֵל׃
verses.english: Then the border swings around it, north to Hannaton;its outer-reaches are the Ravine of Yiftah-El,

verses.hebrew: וְקַטָּת וְנַהֲלָל וְשִׁמְרוֹן וְיִדְאֲלָה וּבֵית לָחֶם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: with Kattat, Nahalal, Shimron, Yid’ala, and Bet-Lehem—towns, twelve, and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: This is the hereditary-property of the Children of Zevulun, for their clans,these towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: לְיִשָּׂשכָר יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הָרְבִיעִי לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: For Yissakhar trad. English “Issachar.” the fourth lot came out,for the Children of Yissakhar, for their clans;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם יִזְרְעֶאלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹת וְשׁוּנֵם׃
verses.english: their border wastoward Yizre’el: Kesulot, Shunem,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲפָרַיִם וְשִׁיאֹן וַאֲנָחֲרַת׃
verses.english: Hafarim, Shi’on, and Anharat,

verses.hebrew: וְהָרַבִּית וְקִשְׁיוֹן וָאָבֶץ׃
verses.english: Rabbeet, Kishon, and Evetz,

verses.hebrew: וְרֶמֶת וְעֵין־גַּנִּים וְעֵין חַדָּה וּבֵית פַּצֵּץ׃
verses.english: Remet, En-Gannim, En-Hadda, and Bet-Patzetz.

verses.hebrew: וּפָגַע הַגְּבוּל בְּתָבוֹר ושחצומה [וְשַׁחֲצִימָה] וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאוֹת גְּבוּלָם הַיַּרְדֵּן עָרִים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: The border touches Tavor, Shahatim, and Bet-Shemesh;the outer-reaches of their border are at the Jordan—towns, sixteen, and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: This is the hereditary-property of the tribe of the Children of Yissakhar, for their clans,the towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַחֲמִישִׁי לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃
