verses.english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the Children of Asher, for their clans.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם חֶלְקַת וַחֲלִי וָבֶטֶן וְאַכְשָׁף׃
verses.english: Their border was[along] Helkat, Hali, Beten, and Akhshaf,

verses.hebrew: וְאַלַמֶּלֶךְ וְעַמְעָד וּמִשְׁאָל וּפָגַע בְּכַרְמֶל הַיָּמָּה וּבְשִׁיחוֹר לִבְנָת׃
verses.english: Alamelekh, Am’ad, and Mish’al;it touches Carmel seaward, and Shihor Livnat.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בֵּית דָּגֹן וּפָגַע בִּזְבֻלוּן וּבְגֵי יִפְתַּח־אֵל צָפוֹנָה בֵּית הָעֵמֶק וּנְעִיאֵל וְיָצָא אֶל־כָּבוּל מִשְּׂמֹאל׃
verses.english: Then it returns toward the rising of the sun, to Bet-Dagon, and touches Zevulun and the Ravine of Yiftah-El, northward, to Bet-Emek and Ne’iel,and goes out toward Cavul on the left/the west,

verses.hebrew: וְעֶבְרֹן וּרְחֹב וְחַמּוֹן וְקָנָה עַד צִידוֹן רַבָּה׃
verses.english: and Evron, Rehov, Hammon, Kana, as far as Greater Sidon.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל הָרָמָה וְעַד־עִיר מִבְצַר־צֹר וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל חֹסָה ויהיו [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה מֵחֶבֶל אַכְזִיבָה׃
verses.english: Then the border turns to Rama, and as far as the fortified city of Tyre] of the fortress of Tyre,” different from ’ir, “city.” The second “returned” in this verse may be a scribal error here, and hence unnecessary. .Then the border turns to Hosa;and its outer-reaches are at the Sea, Mahalav, Akhziv,

verses.hebrew: וְעֻמָה וַאֲפֵק וּרְחֹב עָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: and Umma, Afek, and Rehov—towns, twenty-two, and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: This is the hereditary-property of the tribe of the Children of Asher, for their clans,these towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הַשִּׁשִּׁי לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃
verses.english: For the Children of Naftali the sixth lot came out,for the tribe of Naftali, for their clans;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מֵחֵלֶף מֵאֵלוֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּים וַאֲדָמִי הַנֶּקֶב וְיַבְנְאֵל עַד־לַקּוּם וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: their border wasfrom Helef, from the Oak in Tzaananim, Adami-Nekev) of 15:7. and Yavne’el, as far as Lakkum;its outer-reaches are at the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה אַזְנוֹת תָּבוֹר וְיָצָא מִשָּׁם חוּקֹקָה וּפָגַע בִּזְבֻלוּן מִנֶּגֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר פָּגַע מִיָּם וּבִיהוּדָה הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: The border turns seaward to Aznot-Tavor, and goes out from there to Hukkok.Then it touches Zevulun on the south and touches Asher seaward, and Yehuda, [with] the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,

verses.hebrew: וְעָרֵי מִבְצָר הַצִּדִּים צֵר וְחַמַּת רַקַּת וְכִנָּרֶת׃
verses.english: along with the fortified towns—Tziddim, Tzer, Hammat, Rakkat, and Kinneret,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדָמָה וְהָרָמָה וְחָצוֹר׃
verses.english: Adama, Rama, and Hatzor,

verses.hebrew: וְקֶדֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶעִי וְעֵין חָצוֹר׃
verses.english: Kedesh, Edre’i, and En Hatzor,

verses.hebrew: וְיִרְאוֹן וּמִגְדַּל־אֵל חֳרֵם וּבֵית־עֲנָת וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ עָרִים תְּשַׁע־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Yir’on and Migdal-El,Horem, Bet-Anat, and Bet-Shemesh—towns, nineteen, and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: This is the hereditary-property of the tribe of the Children of Naftali, for their clans,the towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃
verses.english: For the tribe of the Children of Dan., according to their clans,the seventh lot came out;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם צָרְעָה וְאֶשְׁתָּאוֹל וְעִיר שָׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: and the territory of their hereditary-property was:Tzor’a, Eshtaol, and the city of Shemesh,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁעֲלַבִּין וְאַיָּלוֹן וְיִתְלָה׃
verses.english: Shaalabin, Ayyalon, and Yitla,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵילוֹן וְתִמְנָתָה וְעֶקְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Eilon, Timna, and Ekron,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְתְּקֵה וְגִבְּתוֹן וּבַעֲלָת׃
verses.english: Eltekei, Gibbeton, and Baalat,

verses.hebrew: וִיהֻד וּבְנֵי־בְרַק וְגַת־רִמּוֹן׃
verses.english: Yehud, Benei Berak, and Gat-Rimmon,

verses.hebrew: וּמֵי הַיַּרְקוֹן וְהָרַקּוֹן עִם־הַגְּבוּל מוּל יָפוֹ׃
verses.english: Mei Yarkon and Rakkon, with the territory opposite Yafo.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָן מֵהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־דָן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִם־לֶשֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיִּרְשׁוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְלֶשֶׁם דָּן כְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם׃
verses.english: But the territory of the Children of Dan got away from them,so the Children of Dan went up and did battle with Leshem, and took it,they struck it with the mouth of the swordand dispossessed it and settled in it.And they called Leshem: Dan, in accordance with the name of Dan, their ancestral-father.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: This was the hereditary-property of the tribe of the Children of Dan, for their clans,these towns and their farmsteads.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַלּוּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן בְּתוֹכָם׃
verses.english: So they had finished providing-inheritance in the land, according to its borders.Then the Children of Israel gave hereditary-property to Yehoshua son of Nun in their midst—

verses.hebrew: עַל־פִּי יְהוָה נָתְנוּ לוֹ אֶת־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶרַח בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃
verses.english: in accordance with the order of YHWH, they gave him the town he had requested, Timnat-Serah in the highlands of Efrayim;he built up the town and settled in it.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַנְּחָלֹת אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמַטּוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּגוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיְכַלּוּ מֵחַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: These are the hereditary-properties that El’azar the priest and Yehoshua son of Nun and the heads of the Fathers of the tribes distributed-as-hereditary-property to the Children of Israel by lot,at Shilo, in the presence of YHWH, at the entrance to the Tent of Appointment.Thus they finished dividing up the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Yehoshua, saying:

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: Speak to the Children of Israel, saying:Provide for yourselves the Towns of Asylum of which I spoke to you by the hand of Moshe,

verses.hebrew: לָנוּס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה בִּבְלִי־דָעַת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל הַדָּם׃
verses.english: for fleeing to by an [accidental] murderer, one who strikes down a life in error, without forethought,that they may be asylum for you from the blood redeemer.

verses.hebrew: וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאָזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃
verses.english: He shall flee to one of these townsand stand at the entrance to the town gateand speak his words in the hearing of the elders of that town.They shall receive him into the town, to themselves,and give him a place, that he may settle beside them.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃
verses.english: And if the blood redeemer pursues after him,they are not to hand over the murderer—for without foreknowledge did he strike down his neighbor;he did not hate him from yesterday [or] the day-before.

verses.hebrew: וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃
verses.english: Let him stay in that town until he stands before the community in judgment,until the death of the Great Priest that is there in those days;then the murderer may return and come into his town and into his house, to the town from which he fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְדִּשׁוּ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל בְּהַר נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: So they hallowed Kedesh in the Galilee, in the highlands of Naftali,and Shekhem in the highlands of Efrayim,and Kiryat-Arba—that is Hevron—in the highlands of Judah;

verses.hebrew: וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה נָתְנוּ אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמִּישֹׁר מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וְאֶת־רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד מִמַּטֵּה־גָד וְאֶת־גלון [גּוֹלָן] בַּבָּשָׁן מִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: and across from the Jordan [at] Jericho, toward the rising of the sun,they provided Betzer in the wilderness, on the Plateau, from the tribe of Re’uven,and Ramot in Gil’ad, from the tribe of Gad,and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Menashe.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הָיוּ עָרֵי הַמּוּעָדָה לְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כָּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְלֹא יָמוּת בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַד־עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה׃
verses.english: These were the Towns of Appointment for all the Children of Israel and for the sojourner who sojourns among them,to which might flee anyone striking down a person in error,so that he might not die at the hands of the blood redeemer,until his standing before the community.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The heads of the Levite Father’s [Houses] approached El’azar the priest and Yehoshua son of Nunand the heads of the tribal Father’s [Houses] of the Children of Israel

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּשִׁלֹה בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לֵאמֹר יְהוָה צִוָּה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: and spoke to them at Shilo, in the land of Canaan, saying:YHWH commanded by the hand of Moshe to give us towns to settle in, and their pasture-lands for our animals!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלָתָם אֶל־פִּי יְהוָה אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃
verses.english: So the Children of Israel gave the Levites [land] from their hereditary-property, by order of YHWH,these towns and their pasture-lands.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַלְוִיִּם מִמַּטֵּה יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃
verses.english: The lot came out for the Kehatite clans;for the Children of Aharon trad. English “Aaron.” the Priest, from the Levites were:from the tribe of Yehuda, from the Shim’onite tribe, and from the tribe of Binyamin trad. English “Benjamin.”, by lot—towns, thirteen;

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת מַטֵּה־אֶפְרַיִם וּמִמַּטֵּה־דָן וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר׃
verses.english: and for the Children of Kehat who remained from the clans of the tribe of Efrayim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half tribe of Menashe, by the lot—towns, ten;

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת מַטֵּה־יִשָּׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה־אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַבָּשָׁן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃
verses.english: and for the Children of Gershon:from the clans of the tribe of Yissakhar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naftali and from the half tribe of Menashe, in Bashan, by lot—towns, thirteen;

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃
verses.english: and for the Children of Merari, for their clans:from the tribe of Re’uven and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zevulun—towns, twelve.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה בַּגּוֹרָל׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel gave the Levites these towns and their pasture-lands,as YHWH had commanded by the hand of Moshe, by lot.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ מִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְהֶן בְּשֵׁם׃
verses.english: They gave, from the tribe of the Children of Yehuda and from the tribe of the Children of Shim’on, these towns which they called by name;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל רִיאשֹׁנָה׃
verses.english: it was for the Children of Aharon, from the Kehatite clans from the Children of Levi,for theirs was the first lot:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע אֲבִי הָעֲנוֹק הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: they gave them Kiryat-Arba, the father of Anak—that is Hevron, in the highlands of Judah, with its pasture-lands all around it,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵה הָעִיר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶיהָ נָתְנוּ לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה בַּאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: while the open-field of the city and its farmsteads they gave to Calev son of Yefunneh as his holding;

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן נָתְנוּ אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־לִבְנָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: to the Children of Aharon the Priest they gave a town of asylum for the [accidental] murderer—Hevron and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־יַתִּר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: Livna and its pasture-lands,Yattir and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חֹלֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־דְּבִר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: Eshtemoa and its pasture-lands,Holon and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַיִן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־יֻטָּה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים תֵּשַׁע מֵאֵת שְׁנֵי הַשְּׁבָטִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: Devir and its pasture-lands,Ayin and its pasture-lands,Yutta and its pasture-lands,Bet-Shemesh and its pasture-lands—towns, nine, from these two tribes;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֶת־גִּבְעוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־גֶּבַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: and from the tribe of Binyamin:Giv’on and its pasture-lands,Geva and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־עֲנָתוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־עַלְמוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Anatot and its pasture-lands,and Almon and its pasture-lands—towns, four;

verses.hebrew: כָּל־עָרֵי בְנֵי־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה עָרִים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃
verses.english: all the towns of the Children of Aharon, the priests—thirteen towns and their pasture-lands.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי־קְהָת הַלְוִיִּם הַנּוֹתָרִים מִבְּנֵי קְהָת וַיְהִי עָרֵי גוֹרָלָם מִמַּטֵּה אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: Now for the clans of the Children of Kehat, the Levites who remained from the Children of Kehat,the towns of their allotment were from the tribe of Efrayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־גֶּזֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: They gave them a town of asylum for the murderer—Shekhem and its pasture-lands, in the highlands of Efrayim,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־קִבְצַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־בֵּית חוֹרֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Gezer and its pasture-lands,Kivtzayim and its pasture-lands,and Bet-Horon and its pasture-lands—towns, four;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה־דָן אֶת־אֶלְתְּקֵא וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־גִּבְּתוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: and from the tribe of Dan:Eltekei and its pasture-lands,Gibbeton and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־אַיָּלוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־גַּת־רִמּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Ayyalon and its pasture-lands,Gat-Rimmon and its pasture-lands—towns, four;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־גַּת־רִמּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים שְׁתָּיִם׃
verses.english: and from the half tribe of Menashe:Ta’nakh and its pasture-landsand Yivle’am and its pasture-lands—towns, two;

verses.hebrew: כָּל־עָרִים עֶשֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי־קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים׃
verses.english: all the towns were ten, and their pasture-lands, according to the clans of the Children of Kehat who remained.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת הַלְוִיִּם מֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־גלון [גּוֹלָן] בַּבָּשָׁן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים שְׁתָּיִם׃
verses.english: And for the Children of Gershon, from the Levite clans:from the half tribe of Menashe,a town of asylum for the murderer—Golan in Bashan and its pasture-lands,and Be’eshtera and its pasture-lands—towns, two;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר אֶת־קִשְׁיוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־דָּבְרַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: from the tribe of Yissakhar,Kishyon and its pasture-lands,Dav’rat and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־יַרְמוּת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־עֵין גַּנִּים וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Yarmut and its pasture-lands,and En-Gannim and its pasture-lands—towns, four;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה אָשֵׁר אֶת־מִשְׁאָל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־עַבְדּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: and from the tribe of Asher,Mish’al and its pasture-lands,Avdon and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֶלְקָת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Helkat and its pasture-lands,and Rehov and its pasture-lands—towns, four;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־חַמֹּת דֹּאר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־קַרְתָּן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים שָׁלֹשׁ׃
verses.english: and from the tribe of Naftali,a town of asylum for the murderer—Kedesh in the Galilee and its pasture-lands,Hammot Dor and its pasture-lands,and Kartan and its pasture-lands—towns, three.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־עָרֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃
verses.english: All the towns of the Gershonites were, according to their clans—thirteen towns and their pasture-lands.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי־מְרָרִי הַלְוִיִּם הַנּוֹתָרִים מֵאֵת מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן אֶת־יָקְנְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־קַרְתָּה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: And for the clans of the Children of Merari, the Levites who remained:from the tribe of Zevulun,Yokne’am and its pasture-lands,Karta and its pasture-lands,...

verses.hebrew: אֶת־דִּמְנָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־נַהֲלָל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
וּמִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן אֶת־בֶּצֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־יַהְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
אֶת־קְדֵמוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־מֵיפָעַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Rimmon and its pasture-lands,Nahalal and its pasture-lands—towns, four;[and from the tribe of Re’uven,Betzer and its pasture-lands,Yahtza and its pasture-lands,Kedemot and its pasture-lands,and Meifaat and its pasture-lands—towns, four;

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־רָמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־מַחֲנַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: and from the tribe of Gad,a town of asylum for the murderer—Ramot in Gil’ad and its pasture-lands,and Mahanayim and its pasture-lands,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־יַעְזֵר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ כָּל־עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃
verses.english: Heshbon and its pasture-lands,Ya’zer and its pasture-lands—all the towns, four.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הֶעָרִים לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלְוִיִּם וַיְהִי גּוֹרָלָם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃
verses.english: All the towns for the Children of Merari, according to their remaining clans from the Levite clans,their allotment was towns, twelve.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָרִים אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃
verses.english: All the towns of the Levites amid the holdings of the Children of Israel,[were] towns, forty-eight, and their pasture-lands;

verses.hebrew: תִּהְיֶינָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עִיר עִיר וּמִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ כֵּן לְכָל־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: these towns were, town by town, [considered] along with its pasture-lands all around it,thus for all these towns.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָתֵת לַאֲבוֹתָם וַיִּרָשׁוּהָ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃
verses.english: So YHWH gave to Israel all the land that he had sworn to give to their fathers;they took possession of it and settled in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנַח יְהוָה לָהֶם מִסָּבִיב כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם מִכָּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֵת כָּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם נָתַן יְהוָה בְּיָדָם׃
verses.english: And YHWH gave rest to them round about,just as he had sworn to their fathers,so that no man was able to stand up before them among all their enemies—all their enemies, YHWH gave into their hand.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר מִכֹּל הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּל בָּא׃
verses.english: There did not fail one thing of all the good thingsthat YHWH had promised. to the House of Israel;all of it came-to-pass.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua called the Re’uvenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Menashe

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם שְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה וַתִּשְׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: and said to them:You yourselves have kept all that Moshe, the servant of YHWH, commanded you,and you have hearkened to my voice in all that I have commanded you:

verses.hebrew: לֹא־עֲזַבְתֶּם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִצְוַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: you have not abandoned your brothers these many years, until this day,but you have kept the keepingof the commandment of YHWH your God.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לַאֲחֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וְעַתָּה פְּנוּ וּלְכוּ לָכֶם לְאָהֳלֵיכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: But now, YHWH your God has given rest to your brothers, as he promised them.So-now, face about and go you forth to your tents, to the land of your holdingswhich Moshe, the servant of YHWH, gave to you across the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: רַק שִׁמְרוּ מְאֹד לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָלֶכֶת בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וּלְדָבְקָה־בוֹ וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶם׃
verses.english: Only: be very careful to observe the commandment and the Instruction that Moshe, the servant of YHWH, commanded you:to love YHWH your God,to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to cleave to himand to serve himwith all your heart and with all your being!

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־אָהֳלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua blessed them and sent them off, and they went back to their tents.

verses.hebrew: וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה נָתַן מֹשֶׁה בַּבָּשָׁן וּלְחֶצְיוֹ נָתַן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶם מעבר [בְּעֵבֶר] הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה וְגַם כִּי שִׁלְּחָם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־אָהֳלֵיהֶם וַיְבָרֲכֵם׃
verses.english: Now to the half tribe of Menashe, Moshe had given [a share] in Bashan, it was the prized fertile plateau east of the Sea of Galilee and north of Gil’ad.,and to its [other] half Yehoshua had given-share beside their brothers, across the Jordan, seaward.And also, when he had sent them off to their tents, he had blessed them

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר בִּנְכָסִים רַבִּים שׁוּבוּ אֶל־אָהֳלֵיכֶם וּבְמִקְנֶה רַב־מְאֹד בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִנְחֹשֶׁת וּבְבַרְזֶל וּבִשְׂלָמוֹת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד חִלְקוּ שְׁלַל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם עִם־אֲחֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: and had said to them, saying:With much wealth return to your tents, and with exceedingly many livestock,and with silver and with gold and with bronze and with iron and with clothing, exceedingly much;portion out your enemies’ spoils with your brothers!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִשִּׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן לָלֶכֶת אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם אֲשֶׁר נֹאחֲזוּ־בָהּ עַל־פִּי יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: So they returned and went, the Children of Re’uven, the Children of Gad, and the half tribe of Menashe, from among the Children of Israel,from Shilo which is in the land of Canaan,to go to the land of Gil’ad, to the land of their holding which they had made-as-their-holdingin accordance with the order of YHWH, by the hand of Moshe.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְבֵּחַ גָּדוֹל לְמַרְאֶה׃
verses.english: They came to the districts of the Jordan which are in the land of Canaan,and the Children of Re’uven and the Children of Gad and the half tribe of Menashe built a sacrificial-altar there, by the Jordan,an altar large to see.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה בָנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶל־מוּל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל־עֵבֶר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the Children of Israel heard it said:Here, the Children of Re’uven and the Children of Gad and the half tribe of Menashe have built an altar opposite the land of Canaan,in the districts of the Jordan, across from the Children of Israel—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא׃
verses.english: the Children of Israel heard [it], and so they assembled, the entire community of the Children of Israel, at Shilo,to go up against them in force.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶת־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel sent Pin’has son of El’azar the priestto the Children of Re’uven, to the Children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Menashe, in the land of Gil’ad,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשָׂרָה נְשִׂאִים עִמּוֹ נָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לְבֵית אָב לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִישׁ רֹאשׁ בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם הֵמָּה לְאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and ten exalted-leaders with him—one leader, one leader [apiece] per Father’s House among all the tribes of Israel,each one a head of his Father’s House were they, among the thousands as “village-unit” or “militia”; others, “contingents.” of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וַיְדַבְּרוּ אִתָּם לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: They came to the Children of Re’uven, to the Children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Menashe, in the land of Gil’adand spoke to them, saying:

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמְרוּ כֹּל עֲדַת יְהוָה מָה־הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה בִּבְנוֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לִמְרָדְכֶם הַיּוֹם בַּיהוָה׃
verses.english: Thus says YHWH’s entire community:What is this sacrilege) as the one used to describe Akhan’s actions in Chap. 7. See v.20 in the text. by which you have committed sacrilege against the God of Israel,by turning today from [following] after YHWHby building yourselves an altarfor transgressing today against YHWH?!

verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט־לָנוּ אֶת־עֲוֺן פְּעוֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִטַּהַרְנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי הַנֶּגֶף בַּעֲדַת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Was the iniquity of Pe’or too little for usfrom which we have not become purified until this day,—a plague was upon the community of YHWH!—

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תָּשֻׁבוּ הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה וְהָיָה אַתֶּם תִּמְרְדוּ הַיּוֹם בַּיהוָה וּמָחָר אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקְצֹף׃
verses.english: that you turn today from [following] after YHWH?It will be:should you revolt today against YHWH,tomorrow, he will be furious against the entire community of Israel!

verses.hebrew: וְאַךְ אִם־טְמֵאָה אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם עִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן־שָׁם מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה וְהֵאָחֲזוּ בְּתוֹכֵנוּ וּבַיהוָה אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאֹתָנוּ אֶל־תִּמְרֹדוּ בִּבְנֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי מִזְבַּח יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Surely, if the land of your holdings is polluted, cross you over to the land of YHWH’s holding, where the Dwelling of YHWH dwells, and get holdings in our midst—but against YHWH, do not revolt!And against us, do not revolt by building yourselves an altarapart from the altar for YHWH our God!

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח מָעַל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וְעַל־כָּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה קָצֶף וְהוּא אִישׁ אֶחָד לֹא גָוַע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ׃
verses.english: Did not Akhan son of Zerah commit sacrilege, yes, sacrilege regarding the devoted-things,so that there was fury against the entire community of Israel?And he did not perish as [just] one man for his iniquity?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The Children of Re’uven and the Children of Gad and the half tribe of Menashe answered;they spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel:

verses.hebrew: אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהוָה אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהוָה הוּא יֹדֵעַ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא יֵדָע אִם־בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם־בְּמַעַל בַּיהוָה אַל־תּוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: God of gods is YHWH!God of gods is YHWH!He knows, and Israel itself will know:if [it was] in revolting or in committing sacrilege against YHWH—do not deliver us on this day!—

verses.hebrew: לִבְנוֹת לָנוּ מִזְבֵּחַ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה וְאִם־לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְאִם־לַעֲשׂוֹת עָלָיו זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים יְהוָה הוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ׃
verses.english: by building ourselves an altar to turn from [following] after YHWH,or if by offering up offerings-up and grain-gifts,or if by performing on it sacrifices of shalom,may YHWH himself examine it!

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא מִדְּאָגָה מִדָּבָר עָשִׂינוּ אֶת־זֹאת לֵאמֹר מָחָר יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם לְבָנֵינוּ לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּכֶם וְלַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: … if it was not out of deep-concern out of concern that we’ve done this. over a matter that we have done this, saying:On the morrow your children might say to our children, saying:What is between you and YHWH, the God of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל נָתַן־יְהוָה בֵּינֵנוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהוָה וְהִשְׁבִּיתוּ בְנֵיכֶם אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ לְבִלְתִּי יְרֹא אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: As a border between us and you, O Children of Re’uven and Children of Gad, YHWH made the Jordan;you have no portion in YHWH!—Your children would cause our children to cease holding YHWH in awe!

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא לָנוּ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזָבַח׃
verses.english: So we said:Let us act for ourselves to build an altar,not for offerings-up, not for sacrifices,

verses.hebrew: כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין דֹּרוֹתֵינוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת יְהוָה לְפָנָיו בְּעֹלוֹתֵינוּ וּבִזְבָחֵינוּ וּבִשְׁלָמֵינוּ וְלֹא־יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם מָחָר לְבָנֵינוּ אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהוָה׃
verses.english: but rather as a witness let it be between us and you, and between our generations after us,[for us] to serve the service of YHWH in his presence,through our offerings-up, through our sacrifices, and through our shalom-offerings,so that your children will not say on the morrow to our children: You have no portion in YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְאֶל־דֹּרֹתֵינוּ מָחָר וְאָמַרְנוּ רְאוּ אֶת־תַּבְנִית מִזְבַּח יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזֶבַח כִּי־עֵד הוּא בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: And we said:It will be,if they say [thus] to us and to our generations on the morrow,then we will say:See the replica, “build.” of the altar of YHWH that our fathers made,neither for offering-up nor for sacrifice;rather, it is a witness between us and you!

verses.hebrew: חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִמְרֹד בַּיהוָה וְלָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לְעֹלָה לְמִנְחָה וּלְזָבַח מִלְּבַד מִזְבַּח יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכָּנוֹ׃
verses.english: [Heaven] forbid for us to revolt against YHWH, to turn today from [following] after YHWHby building an altar for offering-up, for grain-gift, and for sacrificeaside from the altar of YHWH our God that is in front of his Dwelling!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע פִּינְחָס הַכֹּהֵן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וְרָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Pin’has the priest and the leaders of the community and the heads of the thousands of Israel who were with him heardthe words that the Children of Re’uven, the Children of Gad, and the Children of Menashe spoke,and it was good in their eyes;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַיּוֹם יָדַעְנוּ כִּי־בְתוֹכֵנוּ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מְעַלְתֶּם בַּיהוָה הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אָז הִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד יְהוָה׃
verses.english: so Pin’has son of El’azar the priest said to the Children of Re’uven, to the Children of Gad, and to the Children of Menashe:Today we know that YHWH is in our midst,in that you did not commit sacrilege against YHWH with this act-of-sacrilege;so then, you have rescued the Children of Israel from the hand of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהַנְּשִׂיאִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּמֵאֵת בְּנֵי־גָד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשִׁבוּ אוֹתָם דָּבָר׃
verses.english: So Pin’has son of El’azar the priest and the leaders returned from the Children of Re’uven and from the Children of Gad,from the land of Gil’ad, to the land of Canaan, to the Children of Israel,and returned word to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבָרֲכוּ אֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָמְרוּ לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃
verses.english: The word was good in the eyes of the Children of Israel,so the Children of Israel blessed God,and they decided not to go up against them in force,to wreak ruin on the land in which the Children of Re’uven and the Children of Gad were settled.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֹתֵינוּ כִּי יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: And the Children of Re’uven and the Children of Gad called the altar [:Witness],for it is a witness between usthat YHWH is God!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים רַבִּים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵנִיחַ יְהוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִכָּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים׃
verses.english: It was, many years after YHWH had given Israel rest from all their enemies round about—now Yehoshua was old, advanced in years—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִזְקֵנָיו וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי בָּאתִי בַּיָּמִים׃
verses.english: that Yehoshua called all Israel: its elders, its heads, its judges, and its officials,and said to them:I have become old, I am advanced in years.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְכָל־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃
verses.english: Now you yourselves have seenall that YHWH your God did to all the nations before you,for YHWH your God,he is the one who does battle for you!

verses.hebrew: רְאוּ הִפַּלְתִּי לָכֶם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַחֲלָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְכָל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַתִּי וְהַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: See, I cast [lots] for you from these nations that were left, as hereditary-property for your tribes, from the Jordan—including all the nations that I cut down—and [from] the Great Sea, toward the coming in of the sun.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא יֶהְדֳּפֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִישׁ אֹתָם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת־אַרְצָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָכֶם׃
verses.english: YHWH your God, he will push them out before youand will dispossess them from before you,so that you will possess). their land,as YHWH your God promised you.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲזַקְתֶּם מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כָּל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְבִלְתִּי סוּר־מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃
verses.english: You are to be very strong,in keeping and in observing all that is written in the Record of the Instruction of Moshe,so as not to turn aside from it, right or left,

verses.hebrew: לְבִלְתִּי־בוֹא בַּגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וּבְשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם לֹא־תַזְכִּירוּ וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּיעוּ וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם׃
verses.english: so as not to come in among these nations that are left beside you;the name of their gods you are not to invoke, you are not to swear [by them],you are not to serve them, you are not to bow down to them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּדְבָּקוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Rather, to YHWH your God you are to cleave, as you have done, to this day!

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹרֶשׁ יְהוָה מִפְּנֵיכֶם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצוּמִים וְאַתֶּם לֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: YHWH your God has dispossessed before you nations great and numerous,while as for you, no man has stood up before you, to this day.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִכֶּם יִרְדָּף־אָלֶף כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃
verses.english: One man among you pursues a thousand,for YHWH your God, he is the one who does battle for you, as he promised you.

verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Take care with your very beingto love YHWH your God,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם בְּיֶתֶר הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וְהִתְחַתַּנְתֶּם בָּהֶם וּבָאתֶם בָּהֶם וְהֵם בָּכֶם׃
verses.english: for if you should turn, yes, turn away and cleave to the rest of these nations, the ones left alongside you,and marry among them, so that they come among you and you among them,

verses.hebrew: יָדוֹעַ תֵּדְעוּ כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְלִצְנִנִים בְּעֵינֵיכֶם עַד־אֲבָדְכֶם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: you must know, yes, know that YHWH your God will not continue to dispossess these nations from before you;they will become for you a trapping-net and a snare,a whip in your sides and barbs in your eyes,until your perishing from off this good ground that YHWH your God has given you.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ הַיּוֹם בְּדֶרֶךְ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ וִידַעְתֶּם בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶם כִּי לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הַטּוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם הַכֹּל בָּאוּ לָכֶם לֹא־נָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Here, I am going today the way of all the earth;you know with all your heart and with all your beingthat not one thing has failed of all the good things that YHWH your God promised you;everything has come-to-pass for you—not one thing of it has failed!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם כָּל־הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲלֵיכֶם כֵּן יָבִיא יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם אֵת כָּל־הַדָּבָר הָרָע עַד־הַשְׁמִידוֹ אוֹתְכֶם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: But it shall be,just as there has come upon you every good thing that YHWH your God promised you,so can YHWH your God cause to come upon you every evil thing,until he has wiped you from off this good ground that YHWH your God has given you:

verses.hebrew: בְּעָבְרְכֶם אֶת־בְּרִית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם וְחָרָה אַף־יְהוָה בָּכֶם וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם׃
verses.english: if you cross the covenant of YHWH your God which he commanded you,and you go and serve other gods and bow down to them,YHWH’s anger will flare against youand you will perish quickly from off the good land that he has given you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֶסֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כָּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכֶמָה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Yehoshua gathered all the tribes of Israel at Shekhem trad. English “Shechem,” a city featured in a number of biblical narratives (for example, Gen. 34). It was situated near present-day Nablus, about forty miles north of Jerusalem, and was not part of the territories prominent in the conquest account in the first half of the book. ;he called together all the elders of Israel, their heads, their judges, and their officials,and they stationed themselves in the presence of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua said to all the people:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:Across the River were your fathers settled in former ages—Terah father of Avraham and father of Nahor—and they served other gods.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אוֹתוֹ בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וארב [וָאַרְבֶּה] אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק׃
verses.english: But I took your father Avraham from Across the River) with the term “Hebrews” (Heb. ivriyyim).and I had him go throughout all the land of Canaan;I made his seed many and gave him Yitzhak.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And I gave to Yitzhak—Yaakov and Esav,I gave to Esav Mount Se’ir for him to possess,while Yaakov and his children went down to Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וָאֶגֹּף אֶת־מִצְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחַר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: Then I sent Moshe and Aharon,and I dealt blows to Egypt, with what I did in its midst,and afterward I brought you out.

verses.hebrew: וָאוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַתָּבֹאוּ הַיָּמָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים יַם־סוּף׃
verses.english: I brought your fathers out from Egypt, and you came to the Sea,and Egypt pursued after your fathers with chariots and riders at the Sea of Reeds.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה וַיָּשֶׂם מַאֲפֵל בֵּינֵיכֶם וּבֵין הַמִּצְרִים וַיָּבֵא עָלָיו אֶת־הַיָּם וַיְכַסֵּהוּ וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינֵיכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יָמִים רַבִּים׃
verses.english: They cried out to YHWH, and he put deep-darkness between you and the Egyptians,and brought down the Sea upon them, so that it covered them.Your [own] eyes saw what I did in Egypt!And you stayed in the wilderness for many years;

verses.hebrew: ואבאה [וָאָבִיא] אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אִתְּכֶם וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַתִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם וָאַשְׁמִידֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: then I brought you to the land of the Amorites, who were settled across the Jordan, and they did battle with you,but I gave them into your hand, so that you took possession of their land,and I wiped them out from before you.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא לְבִלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר לְקַלֵּל אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: Then Balak son of Tzippor arose, king of Moav, and he waged battle against Israel:he sent and called for Bil’am son of Be’or to curse you,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁמֹעַ לְבִלְעָם וַיְבָרֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ אֶתְכֶם וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃
verses.english: but I was not willing to hearken to Bil’am,so he blessed, yes, blessed you,and I rescued you from his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְרִיחוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָכֶם בַּעֲלֵי־יְרִיחוֹ הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃
verses.english: Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho,and they waged battle against you, the landowners of Jericho,the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivvites, and the Yevusites,but I gave them into your hand.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַצִּרְעָה וַתְּגָרֶשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי לֹא בְחַרְבְּךָ וְלֹא בְקַשְׁתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: I sent the hornet before youand it drove them out before you,[like the] two Amorite kings—not with your sword and not with your bow.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתֵּן לָכֶם אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָגַעְתָּ בָּהּ וְעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְנִיתֶם וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶם כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נְטַעְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֹכְלִים׃
verses.english: And I gave you a land for which you did not labor,towns which you did not build, in which you settled,vineyards and olive-groves which you did not plant, [and from which] you are eating!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְראוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וְעִבְדוּ אֹתוֹ בְּתָמִים וּבֶאֱמֶת וְהָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וּבְמִצְרַיִם וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So-now,hold YHWH in awe and serve him in integrity and trust;remove the gods whom your fathers had served across the River and in Egyptand serve YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וְאִם רַע בְּעֵינֵיכֶם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־מִי תַעֲבֹדוּן אִם אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר בעבר [מֵעֵבֶר] הַנָּהָר וְאִם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְאָנֹכִי וּבֵיתִי נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: But if it be evil in your eyes to serve YHWH,choose yourselves today whom you wish to serve—whether the gods whom your fathers who were Across the River servedor the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are settled.But as for me and my household, we will serve YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מֵעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהוָה לַעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃
verses.english: The people answered and said:[Heaven] forbid for us, from abandoning YHWHto serve other gods!

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוּא הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְעֵינֵינוּ אֶת־הָאֹתוֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְרֵנוּ בְּכָל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ בָהּ וּבְכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃
verses.english: Rather, YHWH our God,he is the one who brought up us and our fathers from the land of Egypt, from a house of serfs,and who performed before our eyes these great signsand kept-us-safe on all the way that we wentand among all the peoples through whose midst we crossed—

verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־הָעַמִּים וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ גַּם־אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה כִּי־הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: YHWH has driven out all the peoples, the Amorites, the settled-folk of the land, before us.We too will serve YHWH,indeed, he is our God!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם לֹא תוּכְלוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשִׁים הוּא אֵל־קַנּוֹא הוּא לֹא־יִשָּׂא לְפִשְׁעֲכֶם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua said to the people:You will not be able to serve YHWH,for he is a holy godhead accompanied by a plural adjective; the meaning seems to be “divine power.” ;he is a zealous In the form kanna’, God is so described in Exod. 20:5 and 34:14, and Deut. 4:24, 5:9, and 6:15. Woudstra describes the concept as “God’s zeal for the maintenance of his honor”; it is a form of anger. It is often mistranslated as “jealous.” God,and will not bear your transgression and your sins!

verses.hebrew: כִּי תַעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהֵי נֵכָר וְשָׁב וְהֵרַע לָכֶם וְכִלָּה אֶתְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵיטִיב לָכֶם׃
verses.english: When you abandon YHWH and serve foreign gods,he will turn and do evil to you and will finish you off,after having done good to you.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא כִּי אֶת־יְהוָה נַעֲבֹד׃
verses.english: But the people said to Yehoshua:No, rather, it is YHWH we will serve!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם עֵדִים אַתֶּם בָּכֶם כִּי־אַתֶּם בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם אֶת־יְהוָה לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֵדִים׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua said to the people:You are witnesses against yourselvesthat you on your part have chosen YHWH for yourselves, to serve him.They said:Witnesses!—

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְהַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So-now, remove the foreign gods that are in your midst,and incline your heart to YHWH, the God of Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַעֲבֹד וּבְקוֹלוֹ נִשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: The people said to Yehoshua:It is YHWH our God we will serve;to his voice we will hearken!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּרִית לָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּשֶׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁכֶם׃
verses.english: So Yehoshua cut a covenant with the people on that day;he made them a law and a judgment at Shekhem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהִים וַיִּקַּח אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְקִימֶהָ שָּׁם תַּחַת הָאַלָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּמִקְדַּשׁ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua wrote down these words in the Record of God’s Instruction.Then he took a large stone and erected it there,beneath the tamarisk related to the “oak” (ela) in 19:33, above. that was in the Holy-Place of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם הִנֵּה הָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת תִּהְיֶה־בָּנוּ לְעֵדָה כִּי־הִיא שָׁמְעָה אֵת כָּל־אִמְרֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עִמָּנוּ וְהָיְתָה בָכֶם לְעֵדָה פֶּן־תְּכַחֲשׁוּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua said to all the people:Here, this stone shall be against us as a witness,for it has heard all the statements of YHWH which he spoke with us;it will be against you as a witness, lest you deny your God!

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃
verses.english: Then Yehoshua sent the people away, each one to his hereditary-property.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמָת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: Now it was some time afterwardthat Yehoshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died, a hundred and ten years old;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־סֶרַח אֲשֶׁר בְּהַר־אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃
verses.english: they buried him in the territory of his hereditary-property, at Timnat-Serah that is in the highlands of Efrayim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַאֲשֶׁר יָדְעוּ אֵת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And Israel served YHWH all the days of Yehoshuaand all the days of the elders who [lived] long years after Yehoshua,who had known all the deeds of YHWH that he had done for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם קָבְרוּ בִשְׁכֶם בְּחֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־חֲמוֹר אֲבִי־שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה וַיִּהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־יוֹסֵף לְנַחֲלָה׃
verses.english: And the bones of Yosef, which the Children of Israel had brought up from Egypt,they buried in Shekhem, in the portion of open-ground that Yaakov had acquired from the Children of Hamor father of Shekhem, for a hundred kesitas; See Gen. 33:19. The term may indicate a weight or measure of some kind. Some render it as “lambs’ worth.”it had become hereditary-property for the Children of Yosef.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן מֵת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּגִבְעַת פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִתַּן־לוֹ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And El’azar son of Aharon died;they buried him on the hill of Pin’has his son, which had been given to him in the highlands of Efrayim.
